utv.uk.title: Killer In The House - Killer in the House : The Murders of Lesley Howell and Trevor Bu.
utv.uk.description: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them. (Crime, Documentary) - 2026

utv.uk.title: Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South - Antarctica
utv.uk.description: Documentary series. Julia Bradbury journeys to the edge of the world to experience the beauty and brutal conditions of Antarctica as she explores its icy landscapes and extraordinary wildlife - after crossing the Southern Ocean, Julia navigates through thick and jagged brash ice in bays framed by snow-covered peaks. On a whale-spotting mission, penguins and seals surround Julia's boat before a pod of humpback whales finally breaks cover to breath and feed in the bay - donning snowshoes to trek over challenging terrain, she then learns about the harsh reality of life on the ice. During an emotional overnight camp in the stunning Paradise Bay, Julia reflects on her life, family and health - studying the colours and shapes of the icebergs at close quarters, Julia then experiences the raw power of nature as a giant iceberg splits in two and crashes into the ocean just a few metres away, a dramatic end to an extraordinary journey. - 2026

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig decide to go and pick their own strawberries at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm. (S6 Ep16)

5.uk.plus1.title: Tweedy & Fluff
5.uk.plus1.description: Fluff loves to play and can happily enjoy endless games of Whizzy Button. For Tweedy, however, the game must end at some point, so how best to deal with Fluff's expectations? (Ep4)

5.uk.plus1.title: Odo
5.uk.plus1.description: Odo admires Pigeon Post, and when the opportunity arises to deliver messages to campers, he jumps at the chance. (S1 Ep41)

5.uk.plus1.title: Thomas & Friends
5.uk.plus1.description: Millie is very cross with Stephen and Glynn for not helping her when she is given extra work. The next day Stephen cannot find her. Has she run away? (S21 Ep6)

5.uk.plus1.title: Fireman Sam
5.uk.plus1.description: James hopes his dad's massive binoculars will help spot a rare seal, but they cause him to topple overboard, instead! (S15 Ep3)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Grandpa Pig creates a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which, so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The police pick up the signal and become concerned! (S8 Ep8)

5.uk.plus1.title: Pip and Posy
5.uk.plus1.description: Pip and Posy play a fun dragon game with their friends, but Posy loses her temper and accidentally breaks Pip's costume. (S1 Ep20)

5.uk.plus1.title: The Adventures of Paddington
5.uk.plus1.description: ...Halloween Show. It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their special spooky play? (S2 Ep37)

5.uk.plus1.title: PAW Patrol
5.uk.plus1.description: ...Flaming Flounder. Francois's pants catch on fire. (S11 Ep38)

5.uk.plus1.title: Rubble & Crew
5.uk.plus1.description: When Grandpa Gravel is feeling under the weather, Rubble & Crew step in to make his signature soup. (S4 Ep8)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read. (S3 Ep4)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Mr Fox's Van: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken! (S3 Ep45)

5.uk.plus1.title: Tim Rex in Space
5.uk.plus1.description: Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach. (S2 Ep7)

5.uk.plus1.title: Stan & Gran
5.uk.plus1.description: Stan spies a mystery when Grandad's lucky badge is lost on the beach, and an even bigger one when it appears, as if by magic, back in his garden! (S1 Ep45)

5.uk.plus1.title: PAW Patrol
5.uk.plus1.description: When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down. (S8 Ep2)

5.uk.plus1.title: Milo
5.uk.plus1.description: Milo, Lofty and Lark are very polite and friendly delivery drivers. But trying to please everyone leads to one customer being disappointed. (S1 Ep28)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George - an invitation to her birthday party. (S2 Ep28)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Cuckoo Clock: Daddy Pig winds up an old cuckoo clock. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo!'. (S2 Ep34)

5.uk.plus1.title: Peppa Pig
5.uk.plus1.description: Ice Skating: Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before and Peppa keeps falling over. (S2 Ep35)

5.uk.plus1.title: Ben and Holly's Little Kingdom
5.uk.plus1.description: Lucy celebrates her birthday with a party. Lucy's Dad does a magic show but things get a bit out of hand when Holly and her friends join in. (S2 Ep34)

5.uk.plus1.description: Toby the Pterodactyl is trapped on a high cliff. It's time for the Dino Rescue Team to head to the Dino Den and craft a solution with Rex and Ryder! (Ep8)

5.uk.plus1.description: ...Scourge of Our Streets? An e-bike revolution has swept the country but has it become a hazard? We investigate how the boom is out of control and how illegal high-speed versions pose a threat.

5.uk.plus1.title: New: Murder Scene: The Incident Room
5.uk.plus1.description: A house fire appears to kill 96-year-old Emma Finch, but detectives suspect murder. As CCTV, phone data and forensic evidence rebuild her final hours, a lead points to someone close.

5.uk.plus1.title: New: Cause of Death
5.uk.plus1.description: Pathologist Dr Richard Shepherd seeks answers for families as he investigates the mysterious deaths of a healthy teenage boxer in the ring and a student found dead in his flat. (S4 Ep3)

5.uk.plus1.title: My Wife, My Killer & the Secret Footage

5.uk.plus1.title: My Wife, My Killer & the Secret...
5.uk.plus1.description: As the police operation gathers momentum, evidence on Jennifer's phone points to an affair. Interviews with friends, family, lawyers, detectives and Jennifer reveal a remarkable story. (Ep2/2)

5.uk.plus1.title: Ambulance: Code Red
5.uk.plus1.description: Twenty-one-year-old Ryan loses his helmet and suffers serious injuries after a motorcycle accident, and a toddler suffers a seizure so severe he's placed in an induced coma. (S4 Ep5)

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 Talkative primary school teacher Sarah-Jayne is looking for her 'Prince Charming', but would Martin shave off his beard for her? A few weeks after his disappointing date with Regan, Ross returns to the restaurant too.

E4+1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea
E4+1.uk.description: S32 E5 Episode 5 Temps and Abi invite the gang to Dorset - and Temps has a surprise up his sleeve. Sam Prince kisses Maali and Zeyno in the same day, but will he be caught out?

E4+1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E1 Seychelles, by the Seashore Capt. Jason embarks across the waters of the Seychelles with an almost entirely new crew on the motor yacht Katina; Chef Tzarina and Lara are reunited and tensions quickly surface; Tzarina faces an infestation of weevils.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E4 Halloween of Horror One day before Halloween, Homer and Marge arrange scary-looking decorations outside the house as part of their annual Everscream Terrors event.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E8 Paths of Glory In Springfield Town Square, Superintendent Chalmers addresses a crowd of onlookers as the Alternative Energy Derby gets underway. The purpose of the event is for Springfield Elementary students to create and race a vehicle powered by alternative energy.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E18 Father Knows Worst When Homer discovers that the Springfield Elementary canteen meets his dietary needs, he becomes a third wheel in the school lives of Bart and Lisa.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S9 E21 One Exquisite Evening With Madonna After a mould issue at home forces Erica and Geoff to stay at the Goldberg house, Beverly senses tensions in their marriage and seizes the opportunity to impart a little marital advice.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S9 E22 Adam Graduates! Adam's graduation day is approaching and everyone is ready -- except for Beverly, who is not coping well with the idea of an empty nest; with Geoff's encouragement, Erica decides to try out for Cyndi Lauper as a one-time backup singer replacement.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E6 Sebastian's Gordon Ramsay visits Sebastian's, a pizzeria in the heart of movie land in Burbank, Los Angeles, and goes head-to-head with the owner to simplify the menu.

E4+1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4+1.uk.description: E120 Episode 120 Imran refuses to leave Leah's bedside in the hospital. A chase ensues, with Donny and Dodger hot on a resident's tail. And someone is left feeling burnt.

E4+1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4+1.uk.description: E121 Episode 121 Dee Dee's plan to meet her teacher after school goes awry. Dodger encourages Donny to face his problems head on.

E4+1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube
E4+1.uk.description: Shorts A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.

E4+1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4+1.uk.description: Cheltenham In Cheltenham, perfectionist Michelle and her husband, Bryan Adams tribute singer Russell, are the first to host. Day two is Lydia and Calum's turn to host, and they hope a rustic theme will bag them the grand.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E5 Olde Stone Mill Chef Gordon Ramsay works his magic on a New York state eatery that has been renovated but still has horrible service and food.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E14 Giuseppe's Gordon Ramsay visits Giuseppe's, a family-run Italian restaurant in Macomb Township, Mich., that has a chaotic atmosphere in the kitchen and a lack of clientele; to spread word about the restaurant, Giuseppe's hosts a bowl-a-thon.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E3 Bazzini Gordon visits Bazzini restaurant in Ridgewood, New Jersey. Owner Paul Bazzini was an award-winning chef in New York who decided to run his own restaurant, but he never realised how difficult the change would be. Now, he finds everyday tasks overwhelming and his passion for food is in danger of being extinguished by the daily grind. However, passion isn't the only problem in this failing restaurant.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E6 Halloween Claire is all set to "spookify" the Dunphy household, but the rest of the clan aren't as enthusiastic. Cam is haunted by a traumatic childhood experience.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E7 Chirp Phil is preoccupied by a chirping smoke alarm, while Claire and Haley spend some quality time together.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E10 Diatribe of a Mad Housewife Marge writes a novel, 'The Harpooned Heart', using Homer and Ned as inspiration for her characters, while a delighted Homer gets the book-on-tape version read by Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E11 Margical History Tour Marge gives the kids an unforgettable history lesson with three tales about Henry VIII, US explorers Lewis and Clark, and the bitter rivalry between Mozart and Salieri.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E12 Milhouse Doesn't Live Here Anymore When Milhouse and his mother relocate to Capital City, Bart strikes up a friendship with Lisa, and Homer makes money by pretending to be a transient.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E13 Smart and Smarter The interviewer at a gifted preschool insults Maggie, then jealous Lisa leads her astray after she gets accepted.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E16 Edward "Eddie the Eagle" Edwards Barry seeks fresh inspiration when he loses his standing as a champion athlete at school and attempts to introduce a new sport to his friends. Murray refuses to let Beverly help out at the furniture shop when sales take a nosedive.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E17 The Dirty Dancing Dance As they bond over their shared love for the movie Dirty Dancing, Beverly is thrilled when Erica suggests the film as the theme for the upcoming school dance, but Principal Ball refuses to sanction anything with the word 'dirty' in the title, threatening Erica with suspension if she persists with the idea.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E2 When Good Kids Go Bad Mitch and Cam decide to adopt another baby. Now they just need to get little Lily on board. Plus, Gloria locks horns with Manny's principal.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 Phil on Wire Cam embarks on a juice fast and Mitch is helpless as he watches him go through the different stages of dieting. Plus, Phil decides to take up the tightrope.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E4 Door to Door Jay is determined to help Manny sell wrapping paper for a school fundraiser, and Claire petitions the city for a stop sign to be installed at a high-traffic intersection.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E5 Hit and Run There must be something in the air because all the men in the family are angry. While Jay is frustrated at work, Mitch and Cam are involved in a fender bender.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E9 Barthood Bart goes from boyhood to adulthood in a coming-of-age story chronicling his life from six years old to a fully accomplished young man.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E10 The Girl Code After Homer is fired, he returns to his favourite job -- a dishwasher at a Greek restaurant; Lisa accidentally creates sentient artificial intelligence.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E11 Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles Homer buys a new brand of milk, which has major effects on Bart and Lisa. Plus, Bart attempts to woo his new teacher.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E12 Much Apu About Something Having given up pranking, Bart can't resist returning to his trickster life when Jay transforms the Kwik-E-Mart.

E4+1.uk.title: Hollyoaks ᴺᵉʷ
E4+1.uk.description: E122 Episode 122 Arguments erupt in the Hutchinson household. Gemma turns to her dad Donny for help. And Leah flees the hospital in search of answers.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E10 The Pontiac Bandit Returns The Pontiac Bandit is back in custody, where his knowledge of a Giggle Pig dealer earns him a plea deal. Gina and Boyle worry their parents are getting too close, and Santiago makes Holt a Christmas present.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E3 Episode 3 Neuroscientist and geek Michael is yet to find someone with the right kind of chemistry. His date Hannah is hoping her dream man exists outside her romance novels. Melissa has been married three times and is hoping to make it fourth time lucky.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S19 E15 Episode 15 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'Hunted', 'Bake Off: The Professionals', 'Made in Chelsea', 'Love in the Jungle', 'Top of the Pops 1992', 'Dickinson's Real Deal', 'Britain's Got Talent', and 'BBC News'.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S19 E16 Episode 16 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'Starstruck', 'The Home Edit', 'Made in Chelsea', 'SAS', 'This Is Going to Hurt', 'Dynasties II', and 'Pam and Tommy'.

E4+1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E2 Zoe & Derry Zoe is into the 'natural look', but is struggling to meet someone who shares her enthusiasm, while Derry is worried that his jet-set lifestyle is ruining his chances of finding love.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E7 Episode 7 DJ Terry 'Turbo' is back! He worked his charms on three dates in the restaurant previously, but didn't find a match. Now he says he's changed his Jack-the-lad ways.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S19 E15 Episode 15 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'Hunted', 'Bake Off: The Professionals', 'Made in Chelsea', 'Love in the Jungle', 'Top of the Pops 1992', 'Dickinson's Real Deal', 'Britain's Got Talent', and 'BBC News'.

E4+1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E2 Too Many Cooks Chef Tzarina feels the heat as Anthony begins to chafe under her direction. A near collision while docking tests Capt Jason's patience. Lara continues to adjust to the sprawling layout of Katina. And Harry finds himself in a familiar love triangle.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E7 Finn McCool's Gordon comes to the aid of Finn McCool's, a traditional family-run Irish pub in The Hamptons, and makes drastic changes that could affect the family forever.

E4+1.uk.description: S2 E3 Bazzini Gordon visits Bazzini restaurant in Ridgewood, New Jersey. E4+1.uk.description: S20 E19 Waverly Hills, 9021-D'Oh Marge and Homer rent an apartment in the Waverly Hills school district after Springfield Elementary is voted as the worst school in the state. Bart quickly establishes a new bad boy image in an attempt to impress his new fellow students. He also tells everyone that Lisa and pop star Alaska Nebraska are best friends in order to boost her popularity. Meanwhile, Homer enjoys the bachelor lifestyle in their new Waverly Hills abode.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E1 If You Build It With everyone living back at home, the house is full of Goldberg chaos; pregnant Erica enlists Beverly's help in clearing things out for the baby; Adam and Barry are forced to share a bedroom to make room for the baby nursery.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E2 That's a Schwartz Man With both sides of the family eager for answers on Geoff and Erica's pregnancy, they decide to keep their baby's sex a surprise; Adam recruits Glascott to help his mother cope with his departure for NYU.

E4+1.uk.description: Shorts A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's very naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring some sheep.

E4+1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4+1.uk.description: Gloucestershire Husband and wife of 29 years Dave and Pam kick off the competition in Gloucestershire with a farmhouse menu. Day two sees music company owners Alettia and Stuart cook up a meal with a Mexican twist, and finally it's Jake and Helen's turn to host.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E13 Handlebar Gordon Ramsay pays a visit to the Handlebar Restaurant and Lounge in Mount Sinai, New York, where the owners are in denial about its outdated decor and the head chef's lack of passion.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E20 Sabatiello's Sammy, the owner of Sabatiello's restaurant in Stamford, Conn., is more than $1 million in debt when he asks for chef Gordon Ramsay's help; when Gordon criticizes the food, Sammy's temper flares out of control.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E4 Mojito's Gordon visits Mojito, a Cuban café in Brooklyn, New York. Owners Marcelo and Kata used to be married to each other but now fight over everything. Seven years ago, the couple were happy newlyweds and the restaurant was their shared dream, but now the passion has gone, and they're constantly at each other's throats, with their staff getting caught in the crossfire.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E10 Dance Dance Revelation While Jay continues to adjust to life with his young Latino bride and her sensitive son, Claire tries to keep a leash on husband Phil and their brood, and gay couple Mitch and Cam experience the marvels and mayhem of bringing up their adopted Vietnamese baby.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E11 Slow Down Your Neighbors Claire becomes a determined neighbourhood vigilante hoping to catch and stop a menacing car that speeds through their streets. Meanwhile, Phil is busy trying to land an important listing with a difficult client, Jay teaches Manny how to ride a bike (only to learn that Gloria needs lessons too) and Mitchell and Cameron stumble upon a mysterious neighbour who is quite the charmer.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E14 The Ziff Who Came to Dinner When Homer discovers Marge's old flame Artie Ziff living in the attic, a poker game ends in jail for Homer and romance for Artie.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E15 Co-Dependent's Day After a trip to a vineyard, a drunken Homer crashes the car and frames a passed out Marge as the driver to avoid being arrested.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
amc.us.description: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighborhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man, Freddy Krueger (Jackie Earle Haley), terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when one of their number dies violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake. (Horror) - 2010

amc.us.title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
amc.us.description: Murderous ghoul Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) has slaughtered every last child in his hometown. He ventures on to a new location, scouting fresh young victims to hack up with his finger blades. He arrives in a small town in which his long-lost daughter, Maggie (Lisa Zane), works as a therapist for troubled youths. Furthermore, he attempts to recruit her for his dastardly pursuits, but she has other ideas. Father and daughter meet for a bloody showdown that will determine Freddy's fate once and for all. (Horror) - 1991

amc.us.title: The Terror: Devil in Silver - A Number in the System
amc.us.description: Dorry receives a twisted procedure; Dorry knows the devil Coffee, Pepper and Loochie make a plan to fight him; Pepper has a session with Dr. Walter and is reminded of his biggest shame; Coffee discovers what's past the Silver Door. Gunfire and gore. (Horror) - 2026-05-28

amc.us.title: Thinner
amc.us.description: Billy Halleck (Robert John Burke) is an obese lawyer who accidentally hits a Gypsy with his car after his wife distracts him. Given Halleck's influence in town and a general prejudice against Gypsies, he manages to brush the incident under the rug with some unethical legal help from his associates. However, the victim's father, Tadzu Lempke (Michael Constantine), places a curse on the heavyset man, and he starts to lose weight at an alarming rate, which is followed by other macabre events. (Horror) - 1996

amc.us.title: Silver Bullet
amc.us.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: The Cabin in the Woods
amc.us.description: When five college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison, Fran Kranz, Jesse Williams) arrive at a remote forest cabin for a little vacation, little do they expect the horrors that await them. One by one, the youths fall victim to backwoods zombies, but there is another factor at play. Two scientists (Richard Jenkins, Bradley Whitford) are manipulating the ghoulish goings-on, but even as the body count rises, there is yet more at work than meets the eye. (Horror, Dark comedy, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

amc.us.title: House on Haunted Hill
amc.us.description: A millionaire with theatrical tendencies, Stephen Price (Geoffrey Rush) invites a number of people to stay in a vast creepy building that used to be an insane asylum. Stephen, accompanied by his bitter wife, Evelyn (Famke Janssen), offers a million dollars to anyone who can stay the whole night without leaving out of fear. When Stephen and Evelyn become trapped with their guests, they quickly realize that the house really is haunted -- and the spirits dwelling within are very angry. (Horror) - 1999

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Thirteen Ghosts
amc.us.description: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

amc.us.title: Ghost Ship
amc.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

amc.us.title: Trick 'r Treat
amc.us.description: Interwoven stories demonstrate that some traditions are best not forgotten as the residents (Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Dylan Baker) of a small town face real ghosts and goblins on Halloween. Tales of terror reveal the consequences of extinguishing a Jack-o-Lantern before midnight and a grumpy hermit's encounter with a sinister trick-or-treater. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
amc.us.description: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. The elder Taggart soon realizes that the killings and the attack on his son are connected, and, after alerting the community to be on guard, he aims to pummel the Creeper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
amc.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

amc.us.title: Motel Hell
amc.us.description: Vincent Smith (Rory Calhoun) and his sister Ida (Nancy Parsons) run a rural hotel, but they earn most of their cash operating a food stand that specializes in world-famous sausages. After years of success, however, the duo's upstanding brother, Sheriff Bruce (Paul Linke), eventually discovers the grotesque details of his siblings' booming business: Vincent and Ida are actually plumping up their hotel patrons, killing and dismembering them and then grinding them into frankfurters. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1980

amc.us.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
amc.us.description: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret. (Horror, Thriller) - 1995

amc.us.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
amc.us.description: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: The Thing
amc.us.description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Secret Strength
golfpass.us.description: The contestants choose to show their fellow competitors a taste of what they're in for this season as some tiptoe the line between cocky and confident. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Place Your Bets
golfpass.us.description: The contestants face a challenge that's part strategy, part gamesmanship, part skill, and part luck as they're forced to assess each other's games to survive elimination. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Corporal Clutch
golfpass.us.description: One of the cast's favorites is put to the test in a grueling day of golf that will test everyone's mettle. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Is Your Game in Shape?
golfpass.us.description: The remaining contestants get creative and look to earn immunity by showing whose game is in the best shape. Some find out they may need more work than they thought. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Carry Your Weight
golfpass.us.description: Contestants are forced to go long and see who's got the most confidence in their long game. Those who are successful will find out that confidence pays off. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Unlock the Secret
golfpass.us.description: The remaining contestants look for the right combination to unlock success with their short games. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Declaration of Independence
golfpass.us.description: Bold declarations are made, and the remaining contestants must live up to their own expectations if they hope to survive and advance. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Final Four
golfpass.us.description: Accuracy will be tested as the final four contestants become the final three. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Bear Trap Games
golfpass.us.description: The final three competitors take on a stretch of holes that includes the infamous Bear Trap to determine who will play for the title.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Finale
golfpass.us.description: It all comes down to this. Two players, 18 holes, match play, and in the end only one will walk away with the title Big Break Champion. From PGA National Resort and Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Isaac Sanchez & Chad Pfeifer
golfpass.us.description: We catch up with former Big Break competitors Isaac Sanchez and Chad Pfeifer. Sanchez, who goes by the nickname "Sasquatch," is in actuality a gentle giant. But that didn't stop the competitor in him from creating some mythical moments.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Maximum Distance -- Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Focusing on priming the setup and utilizing ground force to increase driving distance.

golfpass.us.title: Cobbs Creek Rising - Headwaters to Horizons
golfpass.us.description: Visionaries create a community campus.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Stewart Cink - Full Swing
golfpass.us.description: One of Georgia Tech's most accomplished golfers Stewart Cink, visits his alma mater's new practice facility, The Noonan, to discuss all things full swing with Brian Bateman.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Stewart Cink - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Stewart Cink, 2009 Open Champion, visits his alma mater's new practice facility to discuss all things short game with Brian Bateman.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Stewart Cink - Putting
golfpass.us.description: From Georgia Tech's new practice facility, The Noonan, Stewart Cink discusses the putting drills, tips and lessons learned over his 20-plus year career.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Sandy Lyle - Full Swing
golfpass.us.description: Masters champion Sandy Lyle breaks down all things full swing and shows how his compact, but powerful swing has been so consistent through the years. Lyle shares how to maximize distance with every club.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Sandy Lyle - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: World Golf Hall of Fame inductee Sandy Lyle shows how to handle difficult lies with minor technique adjustments and gives great advice on attacking tough pins. Lyle also talks about his new putting method that has helped as he has gotten older.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Sandy Lyle - Shots You Need to Practice
golfpass.us.description: Sandy Lyle reveals how to hit a successful shot out of a divot and from under a tree. The 1985 Open Champion also teaches how to control trajectory in windy conditions.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Cascais and Coastlines

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide - 2-Minute Drills - Guide 1
golfpass.us.description: John Montgomery is teaching simple but effective drills that can be done pre-round to improve from tee-to-green. Learn how to stop slices and hooks with the driver, improve tempo and rhythm with your irons and more.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide - 2-Minute Drills - Guide 2
golfpass.us.description: John Montgomery is teaching simple but effective drills that can be done pre-round to improve from tee-to-green. Learn how to eliminate the chicken wing for more accuracy with the driver, fix fact contact with your irons.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Playing Downwind and Into the Wind
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty breaks down the art of playing downwind and into the wind. Nick will guide you through techniques to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust your club selection to take full advantage of the wind.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Right to Left Left to Right
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty teaches techniques and tips for achieving excellent golf performance when playing into the wind. He shows how to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust club selection to make the most of the weather conditions.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Ultimate Distance
golfpass.us.description: The quest for more distance always begins with the driver; to maximize your distance, Devan Bonebrake teaches the ideal setup and swing trigger to increase clubhead speed.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Ultimate Distance
golfpass.us.description: Creating width in the backswing sets you up in the ideal position to add speed during the downswing; Devan Bonebrake demonstrates a drill from Viktor Hovland that leads to a wide, powerful backswing.

golfpass.us.description: Dallas Stars center Tyler Seguin shares different shots that he uses on the ice, specifically the slap shot.

golfpass.us.title: Golf VS - Golf Vs Snowboarding: Shaun White Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how the basics of snowboarding can translate to the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: Golf VS - Golf Vs Snowboarding: Shaun White Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Olympic gold medalist Shaun White shares how snowboarding moves like backflips and complex tricks can translate to the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: Golf VS - Golf vs. Pole Vaulting -- Mando Duplantis
golfpass.us.description: From the differences in sports training to the similarities, join Chris Como as he meets some of the world's best athletes to learn how they prepare and how their skills might translate to the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: Lessons With a Champion Golfer - Shane Lowry - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: 2019 Open Champion Shane Lowry teaches how he controls his driver and iron shots in the wind.

golfpass.us.title: Lessons With a Champion Golfer - Michelle Wie West: Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Michelle Wie West explains her distinctive "Tabletop" putting style and how it helped her win the 2014 U.S. Women's Open; plus, she gives other putting tips and keys to the swing.

golfpass.us.title: Lessons With a Champion Golfer - Michelle Wie West: Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Michelle Wie West breaks down the keys to a variety of shots and provides tips that will help golfers of all skill levels.

golfpass.us.description: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Driver
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers want to get the most out of the driver. They demonstrate what the pros look like at impact and share what to do to get into that position.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Long Game
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward cover all things long game from fairway metals to hybrids and even how to master the dreaded long irons. They also teach how finding the low point in the swing helps create consistent strikes.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Iron Play
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain the big three in iron play: how to control distance, accuracy, and trajectory on shots. They also show a footwork drill to help ball striking and what to do to work the ball into those tucked pins.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Scoring Shots
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain how to dial in distances with short irons and how to hit them on line every time; they also explain the bounce angle and how to choose the right amount.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers show how to play a variety of shots around the green, including the high spinning chip, low runner, and many more. They also explain the importance of focusing on a landing zone when hitting greenside shots.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Bunker Play
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain the necessary fundamentals to hit effective greenside and fairway bunker shots. They also explain how to hit it close from one of the most feared shots in the game, the 30-40-yard bunker shot.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Putting
golfpass.us.description: Me and My Golf's Andy and Piers explain how to master judging speed and reads on the greens. They also demonstrate the proper mechanics for hitting it solid and making those clutch putts.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - From the Rough
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain how to master different lies on the course, featuring the buried lie, sitting up lie, and flyer lie.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Trouble Shots
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain that the best play isn't always the hero shot. They demonstrate how save strokes by hitting over, under, and around trouble.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Course Management
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain how to save strokes by thinking around the course; they'll demonstrate how to take advantage of both sides of the tee-box and the importance of a good pre-shot routine.

golfpass.us.title: Glam Golf With Blair O'Neal - Golf Girl Games
golfpass.us.description: Blair O'Neal competes in a 2v2 match with Sabrina, Alexis and Marissa from Golf Girl Games.

gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 1
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: The 1999-2000 off-season was a sea change for the Lakers, defined by the arrival of Phil Jackson and the move from the beloved Forum into brand-new STAPLES Center. It also started with a setback of a Kobe Bryant hand injury.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 2
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal's renewed focus and dedication takes his game to new heights, resulting with his first MVP award. The team also barrels its way towards one of the best regular seasons in franchise history.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 3 - Brink of Elimination
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: The playoff run includes a first-round series win over the Kings. A hard fought Western Conference Finals between the Lakers and Blazers comes down to an incredible 4th quarter in Game 7, with the Lakers down 15 and on the brink of elimination.

spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.title: Birth of a Dynasty : Chapter 4- The Comeback to Champions
spectrumsportsnetlakers.us.description: After completing one of the greatest fourth quarter comebacks in NBA history, the Lakers prevail in the NBA Finals over the Indiana Pacers in six games, with a monumental celebration outside STAPLES Center.

oxygen.us.description: A Canadian nurse walks into a rehabilitation center and confesses to murdering several of her patients; her childhood best friend reveals their lifelong common bond and the terrifying confession she made to him. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Living With a Serial Killer - Anthony Sowell
oxygen.us.description: East Cleveland is shattered when the bodies of 11 murdered women are found in a house of horrors; as the crimes become public, the killer's sister faces death threats and reminders of a childhood spent with a young man turned monster. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Long Island Serial Killer: Joel Rifkin
oxygen.us.description: Diving inside the mind of New York's most prolific serial killer, Joel Rifkin; through never-before-heard interviews from Attica Correctional Facility, Joel Rifkin reveals exclusive insights into the mind of a monster. (Specials)

oxygen.us.title: Kemper on Kemper: Inside The Mind of a Serial Killer
oxygen.us.description: Former FBI Special Agent John Douglas and psychiatrist Louis Schlesinger take a deep dive into serial killer Edmund Kemper's troubled history, intellect and evolution; the groundbreaking FBI work that led to breakthroughs in catching serial killers. (Specials, Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Dahmer on Dahmer: A Serial Killer Speaks
oxygen.us.description: Inside the mind of America's most notorious serial killer, Jeffrey Dahmer; new revelations and never-before-seen interviews shed light on the grizzly and twisted case, told firsthand from those closest to Dahmer, including family. (Reality TV)

oxygen.us.title: Unknown Serial Killers of America - Billy Chemirmir
oxygen.us.description: When police discover a string of deaths at an upscale retirement community is not natural, they uncover a predator with a motive that defies reason and end up exposing what could be one of the most prolific serial killers in American history. (Regular)

oxygen.us.title: Unknown Serial Killers of America - Mark Goudeau
oxygen.us.description: As Phoenix reels from a wave of violence, a rapist turned murderer and a random sniper plunge the city into fear - forcing detectives to hunt two deadly predators at the same time, and the body count rises. (Regular)

oxygen.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - A Crack in Everything
oxygen.us.description: For the Jennings family, Christmas Eve becomes a waking nightmare after a gunshot rings out, and investigators must determine whether a secret led to suicide or murder. (Docu-Series)

oxygen.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - A Night of the New Moon
oxygen.us.description: Diana Lovejoy and her husband welcome a baby boy, but their marriage crumbles; a bitter custody battle follows; fearing for her safety, Diane turns to a man skilled in self-defense, but as it turns out, someone else is in grave danger. (Docu-Series)

oxygen.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - Twisted in Texas
oxygen.us.description: Meghan Verikas is attracted to Leon Jacob, in part, because as a doctor he saves lives; police officers tell her he is trying to hire a hit man, potentially to take hers, but authorities have a plan of their own. (Docu-Series)

oxygen.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - Tangled Web
oxygen.us.description: Sam and Danielle Dreher appear to have a storybook marriage, but this ending was not happily ever after; when Sam is murdered, investigators discover a twisted tale of secrets, lies and infidelity. (Docu-Series)

oxygen.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - A Shot in the Dark
oxygen.us.description: What happened in Cara Ryan's bedroom is a mystery; she admits she shot her ex-husband, but investigators need to know if it was murder or self-defense; detectives hear several versions of the story, but for a jury, there is only one truth. (Docu-Series)

400000088.description: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in--it's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

400000088.description: A big heart can be a problem for a bail bondsman and today's hunt is a case in point. Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When the local cops put out an APB for a client with a checked past, Dog springs into action. With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring him in.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is back in Denver and in hot pursuit of a woman wanted for identity theft. The sad reality is that the identify which has been robbed is her own. She's traded in a bright future for a life on the wrong side of the law.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs. A passerby in Chinatown tells Dog that Raymond's asleep on a park bench.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

700407.description: Monty Don cuts back his wildflower meadow and, with an eye on some early season colour next year, makes a start on planting up his spring containers. Joe Swift learns the importance of allotment bee keeping when he visits a plot in Bristol.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As well as catching up with various tasks at Longmeadow, Monty Don meets world-renowned garden designer, Piet Oudolf, at his latest creation in Somerset. He gets to grips with Oudolf's iconic naturalistic planting and explains how we can adapt this style to our very own gardens. Meanwhile, Carol Klein goes tree climbing in Bristol to find out how important these precious havens are for urban wildlife.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: We find out how Rachel de Thame got on over the past year as she attempted to grow her own cut flowers, and if you're still in a quandary about what to grow in your winter pots this year, Monty Don may well have the answer.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don is at Longmeadow sharing a wealth of tips and ideas on how to keep your garden looking good all year long. He tackles some urgent pruning, and reveals some of the projects he's got in store over the coming months.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Southampton, sociable bachelor Morgan has £5,000 for a party garden, with a nod to his years at sea working on cruise ships. The space must also have privacy, a water feature and, as a proud Welshman, the feeling of his homeland.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The Rich brothers are joined by Arit Anderson to help create an all-year-round garden in Byfleet for stylish octogenarian Gay, to enjoy the birds and remember her late husband. She wants a garden which is simple to manage, but also welcoming.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Shoreham by Sea, helping John and David. They have £4,500 to turn their tired garden into the perfect place to host their wedding reception. With a relatively small house, the surprisingly spacious outside space must pull its weight.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Karen and Duncan in Shefford complain that their garden is too plain, and they don't like straight lines so they want curves instead. The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson try to create something modern but which also has rustic elements.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the plants in the jewel garden reach the peak of their late summer glory, Monty starts planning for the spring when he plants ferns and gives advice on the care and maintenance of wildlife ponds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With one of the driest summers in many years, Monty responds to viewers' questions and has plenty of advice on how to deal with drought conditions for vegetables, fruit, flowers and containers. Carol Klein celebrates one of the most flamboyant summer shrubs, the hydrangea.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team has been called in to create a garden for a young family to unwind in after work. Zoe and Jonny are dedicated charity workers, who want and need a sanctuary spot to relax away from their emotionally challenging work.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team is in sunny Southsea on the south coast, near Portsmouth. Christine has lived in her home for many decades and it used to boast a beautiful garden, planted and lovingly tended by Christine's now late husband.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Melton Mowbray, in the East Midlands, Allison and Anthony would love a beautiful garden for the family to enjoy but until now their priority has been fully focused on their adopted son Leo, meaning their garden has suffered somewhat.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Milton Keynes, to create a colourful, social space for Vinay and Raunak. Vinay loves to cook, and hosting barbeques and knocking up his signature mojitos are what makes him happy. He is after a garden where he can do that in style.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team help Richard and Darren create a slice of New York's 'High Line' garden in Solihull. The garden has famously turned a disused train line into a thriving garden, mixing contemporary paving, grass planting and historical leftover train tracks.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Hellebores, the jewels of the early spring border, come under the spotlight on this show. Monty Don shares his top tips on how to get the best from them. Carol Klein visits a couple who have just moved into a bungalow with a badly neglected garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don explains why he thinks that the once-popular chrysanthemum is worth revisiting and Joe Swift has some helpful suggestions if you're thinking of giving your garden a bit of a spring revamp.

673500.title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
673500.description: A daydreamer enlists the help of his British con artist friend to steal and sell the plans for a valuable new oil drill in this spy thriller spoof.

673500.title: The Happy Time
673500.description: A large French-Canadian family suddenly expands when father Jacques (Charles Boyer) invites an out-of-work magician's assistant to be their live-in maid. At the same time, charming ladies' man Uncle Desmond (Louis Jourdan) comes back to town to replace a sales manager who has died, and subsequently begins a romance with the new maid. Jacques' son Bobby watches these interactions with confused curiosity as he makes the tough transition from boyhood to adolescence.

673500.title: The Trouble with Angels
673500.description: A Reverend Mother faces an uphill battle to reform a pair of young, hard-to-reach troublemakers who’ve been wreaking havoc on her convent school.

673500.title: Middle of the Night
673500.description: A May-December romance blooms between a 53-year old widowed clothing manufacturer and an employee 30 years his junior, much to his family’s chagrin.

673500.title: Boston Blackie and the Law
673500.description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

673500.title: Queen Bee
673500.description: A naive, working-class Chicagoan enters a world of bitter jealousy and manipulative power plays when invited to Atlanta by her socialite elder cousin.

673500.title: Fire Down Below
673500.description: The long-standing bond between two small-time smugglers sailing around the Caribbean is threatened when a gorgeous siren seeks passage on their boat.

673500.title: Born Free
673500.description: A British couple in Kenya that raises an orphaned lion cub to adulthood train her to live in the wild when a warden demands she be sent to a zoo.

673500.title: Hellcats of the Navy
673500.description: A WWII submarine commander who’s having an affair with a combat diver’s fiancée comes under scrutiny when he’s forced to leave that diver for dead.

673500.title: The Whole Truth
673500.description: Bored with his marriage, a movie producer has an affair with a temperamental actress. When she ends up murdered, all clues point to him as the killer.

673500.title: Only Angels Have Wings
673500.description: Rough and tough Geoff Carter (Cary Grant) runs a tiny airline that cannot afford to miss any flights, despite the dangers along many of the routes. When Bonnie Lee (Jean Arthur), a performer who is falling for him, sees that Geoff is preparing to fly in violent weather conditions, she takes measures to make him stay. She's successful in her attempt, and two of his employees are forced to make the flight for him -- but Bonnie may have been correct about the potential peril of that flight.

673500.title: Divorce American Style
673500.description: A nouveau-riche L.A. couple decide to call it quits after 17 years of marriage, but alimony woes send the bachelor in search of a husband for his ex.

692087.title: Driving Force
692087.description: A man struggles with faith and forgiveness after a drunk driving accident takes the life of his young daughter.

692087.title: Bad to the Jones
692087.description: Bad To The Jones is a story about Craig and Tyrone Jones, two argumentative brothers on a quest to save their sister during a zombie apocalypse.

692087.description: A story of pursuing integrity amid adversity, this film centers around a couple's challenging journey as they bootstrap an indie recording company.

692087.description: Multimillionaire hip-hop superstar Master P is thrown headfirst into fatherhood in the suburbs when he becomes the guardian of his sister’s children.

692087.title: Tides of Deception
692087.description: Two couples' perfect day at the beach unravels after a shocking confession exposes secret desires. As trust fractures and emotions boil over, they are forced to face betrayal, temptation and the messy truth beneath their relationships.

692087.description: Mia and Devin return to her childhood home but must share it with playboy Shannon; Tangi's plans spark Devin's escape and lead Mia to a new job.

692087.description: Sparks fly between a homeless stockbroker and a famous model after the man saves her from a robbery attempt.

692087.description: In the 1970s, an African-American attorney moves his family into the posh, white world of Greenwich, Connecticut—with provocative results.

692087.title: Predators of the Deep
692087.description: When a group of friends sets out to uncover the treasures of a sunken shipwreck, their mission quickly morphs into a nightmarish fight for survival.

692087.title: Klippers
692087.description: After a loan shark hires a hitman to kill his ex-wife in exchange for debt erasal, the job quickly becomes more complicated than anyone thought.

692087.title: The Harder They Come
692087.description: A talented young Jamaican man just wants to be a reggae singer, but finds himself dealing with corrupt record producers and menacing drug pushers.

692087.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
692087.description: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

692087.description: An impressionable college student is introduced to the kinky world and dom fetish of entrepreneur Christian Black in this Fifty Shades of Grey parody.

692087.description: Following the shooting of an unarmed Black teen by two White officers, a city is divided in the fight to seek social justice and reform.

692087.title: Vampire Riderz
692087.description: Chaos erupts worldwide with the invasion of vampires as a pair of vampire hunters set out to find the day walker—the only person able to stop them.

692087.title: God's Purpose
692087.description: An arrogant, wannabe news anchor sets off a chain of faith-testing events and quest for forgiveness after having a misguided affair with an intern.

673498.description: Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

673498.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

673498.title: Western Code
673498.description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.
