movieplex.us.title: Death Defying Acts
movieplex.us.description: Upon arriving in Edinburgh, Scotland for a series of mind-boggling performances, master illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) offers an impressive cash reward to any supposed psychic who can accurately tell him his late mother's exact last words. Gorgeous swindler Mary McGarvie (Catherine Zeta-Jones) rises to the challenge and engages Houdini in a dangerous flirtation that will blur the line between reality and paranoia -- and test the very limits of his skepticism. (Drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2007

movieplex.us.title: The Great Buck Howard
movieplex.us.description: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback. (Comedy drama) - 2008

movies.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
movies.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

movies.us.title: Paranormal Activity 4
movies.us.description: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

movies.us.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
movies.us.description: Teenagers Jesse and Hector look forward to a carefree summer, but the murder of a neighbor leads to a terrifying encounter with the supernatural. After breaking into the neighbor's apartment, Jesse and Hector find a collection of ritualistic art and other bizarre items. Soon after Jesse takes a journal of occult writings, he finds a strange mark on his arm. His subsequent erratic behavior leads Jesse's friends and family to the realization that he is possessed. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

movies.us.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
movies.us.description: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

movies.us.title: Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin
movies.us.description: Strange events plague a documentary filmmaker and her crew when they visit a 200-year-old farm in Amish country to trace her family lineage. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

movies.us.title: The Faculty
movies.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

movies.us.title: The Faculty
movies.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

movies.us.title: Shutter Island
movies.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

movies.us.title: Zodiac
movies.us.description: In the late 1960s and 1970s, fear grips the city of San Francisco as a serial killer called Zodiac stalks its residents. Investigators (Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards) and reporters (Jake Gyllenhaal, Robert Downey Jr.) become obsessed with learning the killer's identity and bringing him to justice. Meanwhile, Zodiac claims victim after victim and taunts the authorities with cryptic messages, cyphers and menacing phone calls. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

movies.us.title: The Lovely Bones
movies.us.description: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2009

movies.us.title: Significant Other
movies.us.description: While on a remote backpacking trip through the Pacific Northwest, a young couple sense they may not be alone. As things take a dark turn, they find there is no one to trust -- not even each other. (Thriller, Science fiction) - 2022

movies.us.title: Fatal Attraction
movies.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

movies.us.title: Basic Instinct
movies.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

movies.us.title: Finestkind
movies.us.description: Two brothers from opposite sides of the tracks are reunited as adults. Desperate circumstances force them into a deal with an organized crime syndicate in Boston, and a young woman gets caught in the middle. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2023

movies.us.title: The Fighter
movies.us.description: For Micky Ward (Mark Wahlberg), boxing is a family affair. His tough-as-nails mother is his manager. His half-brother, Dicky (Christian Bale), once a promising boxer himself, is his very unreliable trainer. Despite Micky's hard work, he is losing and, when the latest fight nearly kills him, he follows his girlfriend's advice and splits from the family. Then Micky becomes a contender for the world title and he -- and his family -- earns a shot at redemption. (Drama, Biography) - 2010

movies.us.title: September 5
movies.us.description: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2024

movies.us.title: True Grit
movies.us.description: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. (Western, Drama, Adventure) - 2010

movies.us.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.us.description: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. (Crime drama, Thriller, Western) - 2007

movies.us.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

movies.us.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

movies.us.title: Gangs of New York
movies.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (Historical drama, Crime drama) - 2002

movies.us.title: The Godfather
movies.us.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. (Crime drama) - 1972

movies.us.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. (Crime drama) - 1974

movies.us.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
movies.us.description: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). (Crime drama) - 1990

movies.us.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 1994

movies.us.title: Sleepy Hollow
movies.us.description: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies. (Horror, Fantasy, Mystery) - 1999

screenpixaction.us.title: The Blood on Satan's Claw
screenpixaction.us.description: When a mysterious corpse is accidentally dug up by a boy in a small town, a group of local teens starts acting very strangely. The adolescents, led by a girl named Angel (Linda Hayden), are convinced the corpse was once possessed. Hoping to get in touch with the devil through the body, the teens act out a series of demonic rituals that causes a stir among the townspeople. When word of the satanic activity spreads, certain parents start trying to lock up the kids behind the spooky stunts. (Horror) - 1971

screenpixaction.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpixaction.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. (Horror) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Black Sabbath
screenpixaction.us.description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff). (Horror) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Blood Bath
screenpixaction.us.description: A reincarnated 15th-century vampire sets his sights on the women of modern-day California. Produced by Roger Corman. (Horror) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: The Premature Burial
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on Edgar Allan Poe's story about a cataleptic Englishman obsessed with the fear of being buried alive. (Horror) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: Burn, Witch, Burn!
screenpixaction.us.description: When a British professor (Peter Wyngarde) ties his success to his wife's (Janet Blair) black magic, he destroys her voodoo kit. (Horror) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
screenpixaction.us.description: After Japanese forces torpedo his submarine during World War II, commanding officer "Rich" Richardson (Clark Gable) is placed in charge of the USS Nerka. The crew on board the Nerka -- led by Lieutenant Jim Bledsoe (Burt Lancaster), who had been passed over for promotion when Richardson was brought in -- is openly hostile to their new commander, especially when it becomes clear that Richardson's sole obsession is finding and destroying the Japanese ship that sank his old vessel. (War) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Huk
screenpixaction.us.description: Greg (George Montgomery) had originally planned on returning to the Philippines only to sell his dead father's plantation. But when he arrives in the country, he finds that it has been overrun by Huk guerrillas, including the rebel leader who killed his father. With the aid of buddy Bart (John Baer) and Bart's wife, Cindy (Mona Freeman), Greg helps defend the local people from the rebels. All the while, he hopes that he'll get the opportunity to settle a painful score from his past. (Action) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Nightmare
screenpixaction.us.description: Stan Grayson (Kevin McCarthy) dreams that he stabs an unknown man to death, but when he awakens, he is disturbed to find that he has bruises that he doesn't remember getting and a key in his room that doesn't belong to him. Confused, Stan explains his situation to his police officer brother-in-law, Rene (Edward G. Robinson), who initially believes that Stan is simply suffering from anxiety. As the evidence continues to mount, however, it seems to point to something more sinister. (Mystery) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Initiation of Sarah
screenpixaction.us.description: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers. (Horror) - 1978

screenpixaction.us.description: A wounded bank robber (Cornel Wilde) hides with his gang at his brother (Dan Duryea) and sister-in-law's (Jean Wallace) farm in a snowstorm. (Crime drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Hidden Fear
screenpixaction.us.description: A U.S. lawman (John Payne) busts Copenhagen counterfeiters to help his sister, falsely accused of murder. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Vice Squad
screenpixaction.us.description: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined. (Crime drama, Action) - 1953

screenpixaction.us.title: Vice Raid
screenpixaction.us.description: New York mobsters use a Detroit prostitute (Mamie Van Doren) to set up a vice-squad detective (Richard Coogan). (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Hong Kong Confidential
screenpixaction.us.description: An undercover U.S. agent (Gene Barry) searches for an Arab ruler's son kidnapped by communists in Hong Kong. (Thriller) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Flight to Hong Kong
screenpixaction.us.description: An importer-exporter (Rory Calhoun) double-crosses his girlfriends (Barbara Rush, Dolores Donlon) and the mob he works for in Macao. (Crime drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Outpost in Malaya
screenpixaction.us.description: An English rubber planter (Jack Hawkins) and his wife (Claudette Colbert) have marital trouble during a native uprising. (Drama) - 1952

screenpixaction.us.title: Top of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: A jet pilot finds himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post. (Adventure) - 1955

screenpixaction.us.title: 99 River Street
screenpixaction.us.description: Cab driver and ex-boxer Ernie (John Payne) discovers his wife Pauline (Peggie Castle) has been cheating on him. Ernie is approached by actress friend Linda (Evelyn Keyes), who says that she needs his help because she killed a man during an audition. After rushing to the theater, Ernie discovers that Linda's desperate tale was the audition. As if that humiliation isn't enough, Ernie is then framed for Pauline's murder by her lover, jewel thief Victor Rawlins (Brad Dexter). (Crime drama, Action) - 1953

screenpixaction.us.title: Big House, U.S.A.
screenpixaction.us.description: Extortionist Jerry Barker (Ralph Meeker) accidentally comes upon a runaway child and uses the opportunity to take the boy and demand a ransom. After collecting the money, Barker flees when he discovers the boy has accidentally fallen to his death. The FBI becomes involved, and Barker is apprehended, but without a body, he's only sentenced for extortion. In prison, Barker is placed with hardened criminal Rollo Lambert (Broderick Crawford), who plots a breakout to get the hidden ransom. (Crime drama) - 1955

screenpixaction.us.title: The Big Caper
screenpixaction.us.description: A crook's (James Gregory) partners (Rory Calhoun, Mary Costa) pose as newlyweds near Camp Pendleton, Calif., to set up a Marine payroll heist. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.description: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck. (Adventure) - 1976

screenpixaction.us.title: True Heart
screenpixaction.us.description: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion. (Children, Adventure) - 1997

screenpix.us.title: The Black Tent
screenpix.us.description: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla. (War) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Tank Battalion
screenpix.us.description: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches. (War) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Dangerous Exile
screenpix.us.description: In post-revolution France, a hot-air balloon lands in Wales with a young boy in tow. Soon the locals discover the mysterious visitor is none other than Louis XVII (Richard O'Sullivan), son of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette. An American named Virginia Traill (Belinda Lee) attempts to shelter him, but word has been sent to the French revolutionaries and young Louis' life is in danger. His only hope is Philippe de Beauvais (Louis Jourdan), a loyalist who wants to restore Louis to the throne. (Adventure) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The Bandits of Corsica
screenpix.us.description: A Gypsy (Richard Greene) covets his noble twin's wife (Paula Raymond) and goods when the brothers team up to topple a tyrant (Raymond Burr). (Adventure) - 1953

screenpix.us.title: He Ran All the Way
screenpix.us.description: Nick Robey is a dim-witted thug who lives with his mother and scrapes by on petty crime. He and his slick accomplice, Al, plot a big-time payroll robbery, but their plan goes horribly awry when they're discovered by a police officer and Al is shot. Nick shoots back, hitting the officer and running for safety. While seeking cover, Nick meets Peggy Dobbs, a lonely young girl. They return to Peggy's house, where Nick holds her family hostage. (Crime drama) - 1951

screenpix.us.title: The Whisperers
screenpix.us.description: Elderly Mrs. Ross (Edith Evans) loses her grip on reality when she begins to hear "voices" that seem to be conspiring against her. Separated from her dishonest husband, Archie (Eric Portman), and living alone, Mrs. Ross is patiently waiting for a windfall from her late father's nonexistent estate. When her thieving son, Charlie (Ronald Fraser), stashes a large sum of stolen cash in her apartment, Mrs. Ross finds it, assuming the money is her long-awaited inheritance. (Drama) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: The Secret of Santa Vittoria
screenpix.us.description: In Santa Vittoria, an Italian town renowned for its vineyards, the residents discover that the occupying Nazi troops plan to take all their wine for themselves. Determined to keep as many bottles as they can, the citizens, led by Mayor Italo Bombolini (Anthony Quinn), try to appease the Germans by offering them a generous number of cases and hiding the rest. Unfortunately, the Nazi leader, Captain Von Prum (Hardy Kruger), realizes that there is more wine, and becomes intent on finding it. (Comedy) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: Diary of a High School Bride
screenpix.us.description: A girl (Anita Sands), 17, and her husband (Ronald Foster), 24, bring a shocking end to the problem of her ex-boyfriend (Chris Robinson). (Drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Rabbit Trap
screenpix.us.description: A family-man draftsman (Ernest Borgnine) finally stands up to his boss (David Brian), because of rabbits and a day off. (Drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Wild Angels
screenpix.us.description: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good. (Action) - 1966

screenpix.us.description: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: A Bullet for Joey
screenpix.us.description: Recruited for a kidnapping, a deported gangster (George Raft) ends up busting a Communist spy ring for a Mountie (Edward G. Robinson). (Thriller) - 1955

screenpix.us.title: Lady of Vengeance
screenpix.us.description: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: To Serve And Protect: Simon is ecstatic when he's elected as the school's safety monitor. But when Alvin goofs off at school, Simon faces a moral dilemma. (S1, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Pirates Life: When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. (S4, ep 6a)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Gossip Guy: The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students. (S4, ep 18b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Double Trouble: Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's bound to be double the trouble.

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real. (S3, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Coach Dobkins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team in 'Between a Rope and A Hard Place', then in 'World Day', The Chipmunks each get represent a country for a school presentation. (S4, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin takes Simon's place on a camping trip in 'Excavation Vacation', and in 'Trophy Dad', The Chipmunks suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won. (S5, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much in 'Alvin Management', then in 'Time Capsule', the school digs up an old high school time capsule, and Miss Smith and Dave keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool! (S2, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin kidnaps Simon's robot Geizmo in 'Geizmo's Day Out', then in 'Unbored', when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy. (S4, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor in 'Allergic Reaction', then in 'Lice-enced to Teach', Dave sets up a classroom in the house, and becomes the teacher. (S4, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but must keep the puppy hidden from Dave in 'Dog Days', then in 'Dragon Dad', Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon. (S2, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched. (S1, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave refuses to let Alvin get a dangerous toy sports car in 'Safety Third', then in 'Mister Manners', Alvin must pass a manners course before he gets his dream meeting with a Princess. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.description: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.description: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game in 'The Chosen Chipmunk', then in 'Double Dangus', Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully, which will not do. (S4, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin talks Dave into a poor scheme in 'Tour Bus', then in 'Game Show', Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts. (S4, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin's convinced Dave will abandon him in the desert in 'Deserted', and in 'The Great Snack Off', Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences. (S5, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.description: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind. (S5, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it. (S1, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks help mend a friendship in 'Summer Camp', and in 'Blabber Mouth', Alvin thinks that Theodore has cursed him to never lie again, and can't help himself from blabbing the truth. (S2, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job. (S3, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them. (S5, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.description: Dave is concerned that The Chipmunks are obsessed with a video game in 'Mystic Mountain', and in 'Candy Confessions', Alvin wants a skateboard, but Theodore uses the money to buy sweets. (S1, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Principal's cat goes missing in 'The Music Box', then in 'Special Delivery', Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box, so Simon and Alvin have to get him home. (S2, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The girls are remembering their home in 'The Tree House', then in 'Saving Simon', Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to a boarding school, and try to keep him at home. (S1, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory in 'Mutiny', then in 'Reality or Not', Alvin is tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by Reality TV stars. (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin pretends to write a broadway show in 'Writer's Blocked', and in 'Jinxed!', after Theodore sees Alvin accidentally ruin Dave's computer, Alvin jinxes Theodore so he can't tell on him. (S5, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin has summer school and Dave must not find out in 'Summer School', and in 'Puzzled', when Theodore drops a puzzle piece down a vent, he gets trapped inside while trying to fish it out. (S5, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave gets bad reviews on the internet in 'You Troll', then in 'Life of the Party', The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash BoCarter's party after not being invited. (S4, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much in 'Alvin Management', then in 'Time Capsule', the school digs up an old high school time capsule, and Miss Smith and Dave keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind. (S5, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor and Jeanette wonder if Brittany would care for them in 'Sick as a Chipmunk', then in 'Instant Gram, Dave makes several embarrassing posts on social media, and Alvin tries to help. (S4, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory in 'Mutiny', then in 'Reality or Not', Alvin is tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by Reality TV stars. (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend in 'Slippin Thru My Fingers', then in 'Driving Dave Crazy', the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for the music festival. (S1, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his destiny in 'Theodore's Calling', then in 'Clumsy Jeanette', Jeanette's new glasses cause a clumsy change. (S4, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame? (S5, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time in'Time Flies', and in 'Prank Calls', a prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when someone vows to track him down! (S2, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Eleanor train to be lifeguards in 'The Lifeguard', then in 'Scarecrowner', Miss Croner's prized cherries go missing, and she suspects crows - but could it be chipmunks? (S5, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a 30-foot giant in 'Theozilla', then in 'Doggone It', all the phones at school are missing, and Alvin is blamed. (S1, ep 21)

screenpixvoices.us.title: Gabriela
screenpixvoices.us.description: A rich Turkish bar owner (Sônia Braga) falls in love with his beautiful Brazilian cook (Marcello Mastroianni). (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1983

screenpixvoices.us.title: Go Fish
screenpixvoices.us.description: After leaving behind her girlfriend to attend college in Chicago, young lesbian Max West (Guinevere Turner) is introduced to Ely (V.S. Brodie), a slightly older woman with quirky habits. While Max and Ely quickly develop an attraction to each other, a poorly timed phone call from Max's long-distance girlfriend, Kate, brings things to an abrupt halt. Meanwhile, Max's roommate, Kia (T. Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home. (Comedy, LGBTQ) - 1994

screenpixvoices.us.title: Feast of Love
screenpixvoices.us.description: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades. (Comedy drama) - 1995

screenpixvoices.us.title: Love Chronicles
screenpixvoices.us.description: A disc jockey and a therapist help callers on a radio program sort through their relationship issues. (Drama, Romance) - 2003

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Mama, White Mama
screenpixvoices.us.description: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away. (Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (Crime drama) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sheba, Baby
screenpixvoices.us.description: When the loan business of her father, Andy (Rudy Challenger), is trashed by thugs looking to force a sale, Chicago private investigator Sheba Shayne (Pam Grier) travels back to her hometown of Louisville, Ky., to even the score. Together with old flame Brick Williams (Austin Stoker), she attacks the henchmen of local loan shark Pilot (D'Urville Martin), but a retaliation leaves Andy dead. Blind with rage, Sheba vows to take out Pilot's boss, mob kingpin Shark (Dick Merrifield). (Action) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
screenpixvoices.us.description: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates. (Action) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Drum
screenpixvoices.us.description: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans. (Drama) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
screenpixvoices.us.description: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down. (Comedy) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Wild Pair
screenpixvoices.us.description: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists. (Action) - 1987

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists. (Western, Comedy) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iron Sheriff
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Ride Out for Revenge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards). (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Winterhawk
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A Montana trapper (Leif Erickson) leads the search for a boy and a girl kidnapped by a noble Indian chief (Michael Dante). (Western) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Billy Two Hats
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After a bank robbery goes wrong, outlaw Billy Two Hats (Desi Arnaz Jr.) is captured by Sheriff Gifford (Jack Warden). Billy's partner, Arch Deans (Gregory Peck), rescues him, but during the escape Deans gets shot in the leg. The wound leaves Deans unable to ride a horse, but Billy refuses to leave him behind. Instead, he builds a horse-drawn cot for him, and they continue together. The apparatus slows them down, however, making them even more vulnerable to capture from the pursuing sheriff. (Western) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blazing Guns
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The governor sends the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) to tame a cow town. (Western) - 1943

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Drums
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether to return when war with the Apaches erupts. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Debt of Honor
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Crooks target old prospector Cactus Charlie after he discovers their hidden stash of stolen gold. (Western) - 1960-09-29

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Law of the Land
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A railroad company draws suspicion when lines of barbed-wire fencing disappear from the ranches near its rail lines, calling the rightful owner of the land into question. (Western) - 1960-10-06

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Gun Fever
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After Neal Wheaton guns down a civilian, Clay makes the tough decision to fire him; Clay orders Neal to leave town. (Western) - 1958-01-22

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Mexican Bandito
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister disguises himself as an outlaw to catch a Mexican bandit who killed a bank teller during a robbery. (Western) - 1958-01-29

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Utah Kid
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A lawman and a rodeo rider go after a gang that's been bribing and doping rodeo contestants to affect the outcome and make a bundle of cash. (Western) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Belt
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop). (Western) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.description: After a bank robbery goes wrong, outlaw Billy Two Hats (Desi Arnaz Jr.) is captured by Sheriff Gifford (Jack Warden). Billy's partner, Arch Deans (Gregory Peck), rescues him, but during the escape Deans gets shot in the leg. The wound leaves Deans unable to ride a horse, but Billy refuses to leave him behind. Instead, he builds a horse-drawn cot for him, and they continue together. The apparatus slows them down, however, making them even more vulnerable to capture from the pursuing sheriff. (Western) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Bat Trap
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat presides over a shooting contest and must confront a bully who cheats his way to first place. (Western) - 1960-10-13

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Rage of Princess Anne
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat must convince the owners of a dangerous Colorado mine to halt work before an accident occurs. (Western) - 1960-10-20

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Tong War
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister springs into action when an alleged thief and his girlfriend go missing. (Western) - 1958-02-05

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Postmarked for Death
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The sheriff investigates after a postmaster is gunned down during a mail run. (Western) - 1958-02-12

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Navajo Joe
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Proud warrior Navajo Joe (Burt Reynolds) is the only man left alive when outlaw Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell) and his brutal gang destroy his village. Riding into a nearby town of white settlers, Joe announces his plans for vengeance, but the townspeople fear Duncan's retribution too much to stand behind him. In the course of his one-man battle against Duncan's small army for control of the town, Joe falls for beautiful maid Estella (Nicoletta Machiavelli). (Western) - 1966

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Defiance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny. (Western) - 1951

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Brass Legend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. Linda's little brother, Clay, happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Massacre
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson (Joel McCrea) takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney (Forrest Tucker), question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas. (Historical drama) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Young Billy Young
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son. (Western) - 1969

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Halliday Brand
screenpixwesterns.us.description: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iroquois Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War. (Western) - 1950
