screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Hunter
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An Englishman decides to test his customized pistol on Bat. (Western) - 1960-10-27

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Murder Can Be Dangerous
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat ejects a business partner from a casino after he catches the man embezzling money, but instead of deterring the crook, Bat only provokes his ire. (Western) - 1960-11-03

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Johnny Ringo's Last Ride
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister must track down his pal who robs fellow poker players after losing everything. (Western) - 1958-02-19

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Outlaw's Bugle
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sheriff Hollister is forced to defend himself when a newspaper attempts to influence public opinion against him. (Western) - 1958-02-26

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Ned Kelly
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In this movie based on a true story, Ned Kelly (Mick Jagger) has served a three-year prison sentence for stealing horses and is released. However, he cannot even begin to get his life in order before his mother (Clarissa Kaye) is arrested and falsely charged with murder. This is the last straw for Ned, who goes on a crime spree with his group, including Joe Byrne (Mark McManus) and Ned's brother, Dan (Allen Bickford). However, eventually the law catches up to them, forcing a fateful showdown. (Biography) - 1970

showtimenext.us.title: Rush Hour
showtimenext.us.description: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 1998

showtimenext.us.title: Rush Hour 2
showtimenext.us.description: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2001

showtimenext.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtimenext.us.description: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2007

showtimenext.us.title: A Haunted House
showtimenext.us.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. (Comedy, Horror) - 2013

showtimenext.us.title: A Haunted House 2
showtimenext.us.description: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. (Comedy, Horror) - 2014

showtimenext.us.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
showtimenext.us.description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. (Romantic comedy) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: Walking Out
showtimenext.us.description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. (Adventure, Drama) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: I, Daniel Blake
showtimenext.us.description: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. (Drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: The Lovely Bones
showtimenext.us.description: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2009

showtimenext.us.title: Wakefield
showtimenext.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Mr. Holmes
showtimenext.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. (Mystery, Drama) - 2015

showtimenext.us.title: I Used to Go Here
showtimenext.us.description: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. (Comedy) - 2020

showtimenext.us.title: Not Without Hope
showtimenext.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: Dean
showtimenext.us.description: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies. (Comedy drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimenext.us.description: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. (Musical) - 2012

showtimenext.us.title: Almost Famous
showtimenext.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama) - 2000

showtimenext.us.title: Super
showtimenext.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. (Action, Comedy) - 2010

showtimenext.us.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
showtimenext.us.description: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career. (Documentary, Comedy) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: The Outlaws
showtimenext.us.description: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Confess, Fletch
showtimenext.us.description: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. (Comedy, Mystery) - 2022

showtimenext.us.title: Prison Fighters: 5 Rounds to Freedom
showtimenext.us.description: An examination of a practice in Thailand's criminal justice system, where inmates are given the opportunity to earn their freedom through Muay Thai fighting. (Special, Documentary) - 2017-02-24

showtimenext.us.title: Memory
showtimenext.us.description: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. (Drama) - 2023

showtimenext.us.title: Rebel in the Rye
showtimenext.us.description: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: She's Out of My League
showtimenext.us.description: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

showtimenext.us.title: Daniela Forever
showtimenext.us.description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. (Science fiction, Romance) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Election
showtimenext.us.description: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

showtimenext.us.title: Queen of the Desert
showtimenext.us.description: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2015

showtimenext.us.title: Side Effects
showtimenext.us.description: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death. (Drama, Thriller) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtimewomen.us.description: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

showtimewomen.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
showtimewomen.us.description: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Boudica: Queen of War
showtimewomen.us.description: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance. (Historical drama, War, Action) - 2023

showtimewomen.us.title: Organ Trail
showtimewomen.us.description: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. (Western, Horror, Thriller) - 2023

showtimewomen.us.title: Sound of Violence
showtimewomen.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

showtimewomen.us.title: A Perfect Murder
showtimewomen.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

showtimewomen.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimewomen.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: The Devil Inside
showtimewomen.us.description: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: The Uninvited
showtimewomen.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: Sweetness
showtimewomen.us.description: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. (Thriller) - 2025

showtimewomen.us.title: True Grit
showtimewomen.us.description: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. (Western, Drama, Adventure) - 2010

showtimewomen.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
showtimewomen.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. (Comedy drama) - 2015

showtimewomen.us.title: The Intern
showtimewomen.us.description: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. (Comedy drama) - 2015

showtimewomen.us.title: My Cousin Vinny
showtimewomen.us.description: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully. (Comedy, Drama) - 1992

showtimewomen.us.title: Furlough
showtimewomen.us.description: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. (Comedy) - 2018

showtimewomen.us.title: We're the Millers
showtimewomen.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action, Crime drama) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: Election
showtimewomen.us.description: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. showtimewomen.us.title: Guns Up
showtimewomen.us.description: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. (Action, Comedy) - 2025

Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. showtimewomen.us.title: She's All That
showtimewomen.us.description: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. skyselect.uk.title: Flushed Away (2006)
skyselect.uk.description: A spoiled rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins and make his way back to his plush home. - 2006

skyselect.uk.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie (2002)
skyselect.uk.description: A feature-length spin-off from the TV series, the Thornberry family - led by natural history film-maker Colonel Radcliff Thornberry - head to deepest Africa. Once there, daughter Eliza - after meeting a shaman - can talk to the animals, a skill that stands her in good stead to foil a dastardly plot by poachers to kill a herd of elephants for their ivory. - 2002

skyselect.uk.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie (2004)
skyselect.uk.description: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr Krab, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr Krab's life. - 2004

skyselect.uk.title: Puss in Boots (2011)
skyselect.uk.description: The notorious cat has the adventure of nine lifetimes when he joins forces with Humpty Dumpty and Kitty Softpaws to steal the goose that lays the golden eggs. A DreamWorks animation. - 2011

skyselect.uk.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax (2012)
skyselect.uk.description: A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax. - 2012

skyselect.uk.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie (2002)
skyselect.uk.description: A feature-length spin-off from the TV series, the Thornberry family - led by natural history film-maker Colonel Radcliff Thornberry - head to deepest Africa. skyselect.uk.description: A young Viking with aspirations of becoming a dragon hunter befriends a young dragon himself and learns more about the creatures than he ever assumed. - 2010

skyselect.uk.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2 (2014)
skyselect.uk.description: After discovering a secret cave filled with wild dragons and their mysterious benefactor, Hiccup and Toothless find themselves at the centre of a battle to protect the peace of Berk. A DreamWorks animation. - 2014

skyselect.uk.title: Antz (1998)
skyselect.uk.description: Visually exuberant tale about a neurotic ant who struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves. - 1998

skyselect.uk.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman (2014)
skyselect.uk.description: Mr. Peabody, the most accomplished canine in the world, and his boy, Sherman, use a time machine called the Wabac to embark on outrageous adventures. However, when Sherman takes the Wabac without permission to impress his friend Penny, he accidentally rips a hole in the universe and causes havoc with world history. It's up to Mr. Peabody to mount a rescue and prevent the past, present and future from being permanently altered. A DreamWorks animation. - 2014

skyselect.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
skyselect.uk.description: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky. (Comedy / Fantasy / Animated / Children) - 2009

skyselect.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2 (2013)
skyselect.uk.description: Discovering that his most-famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures. (Comedy / Animated / Children) - 2013

skyselect.uk.title: Penguins of Madagascar (2014)
skyselect.uk.description: The plucky penguins join a special inter-species task force in an attempt to stop an evil doctor from taking over the world. - 2014

skyselect.uk.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005)
skyselect.uk.description: The village is being overrun by rabbits and Wallace has a plan to alter their minds so that they will leave the vegetable allotments alone. However, his plan goes awry and the rabbit problem escalates when the villagers discover a monstrous `were-rabbit' destroying everything in its sights. Will Wallace and Gromit be able to solve the conundrum before the creature gets shot. - 2005

skyselect.uk.title: Monster House (2006)
skyselect.uk.description: Young DJ and his pals set out to discover what bloodcurdling secrets lie behind the front door of the scary house across the street. When the house comes alive and starts eating people, have the kids bitten off more than they can chew. - 2006

skyselect.uk.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim (2024)
skyselect.uk.description: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance. (Action / Adventure / Fantasy / Anime) - 2024

skyselect.uk.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass (2025)
skyselect.uk.description: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home. (Adventure / Comedy / Animated) - 2025

skyselect.uk.description: Based on the comic books. - 2018

skyselect.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree. - 2025

skyselect.uk.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure With Scientists (2012)

His journey takes him to Victorian London where the Pirate Captain must choose between winning Pirate of the Year, or helping his crew. - 2012

skyselect.uk.title: Despicable Me 2 (2013)

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to China, a twelve-year-old boy falls in love with one of his classmates. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Liar Liar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After the three young Baudelaire siblings are left orphaned by a fire in their mansion, they are carted off to live with their distant relative, Count Olaf. Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore

Abrams of the murder of a race jockey, but Nick refuses to get involved. Approached later by athletics commission head Maj. Jason Scully and reporter Paul Clarke, Nick still declines to investigate. When another reporter is murdered and Paul is arrested, Nick gives way to Nora's plea and, with their fox terrier Asta, sets out to solve the murders. (Comedy drama, Romance, Mystery) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thin Man Goes Home
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Famous retired detective Nick Charles (William Powell) takes his wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), and their dog, Asta, to visit Nick's parents in their small, quiet town. Determined that Nick's father respect Nick's profession, Nora urges him to find a crime to investigate, unaware that Nick's presence has already frightened spy Edgar Draque (Leon Ames) into action. After Nora buys a painting for Nick's birthday and the artist is murdered, Nick discovers that the murder is connected to espionage. (Comedy drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Song of the Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tommy Drake (Philip Reed), a musician aboard a gambling ship, is shot and killed while trying to break into a safe. Later, amateur sleuths Nick (William Powell) and Norah (Myrna Loy) receive a visit from Phil Brant, Drake's former boss and the main suspect in his murder. After they give Brant up to the authorities, they start digging around for clues. The pair question Brant's wife and one of Drake's musician colleagues until they start to piece together the intricate puzzle. (Comedy, Crime drama, Mystery) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling Dr. Kildare
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Senior physician Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) sends his student, the overconfident intern James Kildare (Lew Ayres), to work in the dispensary with nurse Mary Lamont (Laraine Day). There, a man unwilling to go to emergency pleads with Kildare to examine his friend, who has been shot. Kildare treats and hides the wounded man, whom he learns is a murder suspect. Smitten by the victim's attractive sister, Rosalie (Lana Turner), Kildare offers to help prove her brother's innocence. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Foreign Correspondent
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders). (Thriller) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After an outlaw, Pancho Lopez (Wallace Beery), steals cattle from the ranch of Gil (Ronald Reagan) and his uncle Henry (Lionel Barrymore), they face foreclosure to banker Hardy (Henry Travers). When Gil's old love, Lucia (Laraine Day), shows up, her husband (Tom Conway) wants to buy the land, believing there is oil on it. However, Pancho soon arrives and kidnaps everyone except Gil. Pancho realizes that Gil had previously saved his life, so he attempts to help Gil get back on track. (Western) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Journey for Margaret
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the midst of war-torn London, American journalist John Davis (Robert Young) and his wife, Nora (Laraine Day), lose their unborn baby in a bombing raid. The resultant surgery leaves Nora barren, and, while she returns to the United States to recuperate, John stays in England. When he takes young orphans Margaret (Margaret O'Brien) and Peter (William Severn) under his wing, John decides that he wants to remove the children from harm's way and bring them home to America. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mr. Lucky
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Joe Adams (Cary Grant) is as clever as they come. Certain that he'll be called up during World War II, Joe nabs the draft papers of a man who's been freed from service and leverages his position into a potentially lucrative scam. The captain of a commercial ship, Joe cons war volunteer Dorothy Bryant (Laraine Day) into believing that he's planning a fund drive for the troops. In fact, he's got something more devious in mind. But as Joe rethinks things, he finds his ruse is already in motion. (Comedy drama) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Locket
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Flashbacks show why a psychiatrist (Brian Aherne) warned a man not to marry his ex-wife (Laraine Day). (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman on Pier 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: All That Heaven Allows
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Predicated on a May-December romance. The difference here is that the woman, attractive widow Cary Scott (Jane Wyman), is considerably older than the man, handsome gardener-landscaper Ron Kirby (Rock Hudson). Throwing conventional behavior to the winds and facing social ostracism, Cary pursues her romance with Ron, who is unjustly perceived as a fortune-hunter by Cary's friends and family -- especially her priggish brother Ned (William Reynolds). (Romance) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Leave Her to Heaven
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Trouble With Harry
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a local man's corpse appears on a nearby hillside, no one is quite sure what happened to him. Many of the town's residents secretly wonder if they are responsible, including the man's ex-wife, Jennifer (Shirley MacLaine), and Capt. Albert Wiles (Edmund Gwenn), a retired seaman who was hunting in the woods where the body was found. As the no-nonsense sheriff (Royal Dano) gets involved and local artist Sam Marlowe (John Forsythe) offers his help, the community slowly unravels the mystery. (Comedy) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Cobweb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a psychiatric clinic for the elite, Dr. Stewart McIver (Richard Widmark) wants to institute a policy of self-governance among his patients. To further his goals, Dr. McIver proposes that residents collaborate to design and make new drapes for the clinic library. Though it seems inconsequential, trouble ensues when the clinic patients become locked in a power struggle with the equally unbalanced staff, including activities director Meg Rinehart (Lauren Bacall). (Drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Daytrippers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet November
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Outward Bound
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A group of strangers finds themselves aboard an unmanned ship, surrounded by fog and uncertain of their destination. As they attempt to make sense of their situation, the group of passengers, which include a man (Leslie Howard) and his long-lost mother (Beryl Mercer), discover that all they have in common is that each is dead and en route to their final judgment by Thompson (Dudley Digges). However, two desperate lovers, Henry (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) and Ann (Helen Chandler), may be different. (Drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smilin' Through
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the day of his wedding, Sir John Carteret's fiancée, Moonyeen, is killed by a jealous rival named Jeremy, leaving him emotionally devastated. Carteret spends three decades in seclusion, mostly communing with the spirit of Moonyeen, until he learns that her niece, Kathleen (also Shearer), has become an orphan. He adopts and raises the child as his own but is alarmed when, as a young woman, she falls in love with the son of Moonyeen's murderer. (Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Romeo and Juliet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic Hollywood take on Shakespeare's tragic romance, dashing young Romeo (Leslie Howard), a Montague, falls in love with the radiant Juliet (Norma Shearer), a member of the Capulet family, the Montagues' sworn enemies. Willing to defy the families' feud, the two secretly get married, however their happy day turns tragic when Juliet's cousin, Tybalt (Basil Rathbone) kills Romeo's best friend, Mercutio (John Barrymore), prompting Romeo to retaliate. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Petrified Forest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe, and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage. (Drama) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It's Love I'm After
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pygmalion
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation. (Romantic comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 49th Parallel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey). (Thriller) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen. (Comedy) - 1975

themoviechannel.us.title: Daddy's Home
themoviechannel.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Tommy Boy
themoviechannel.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Office Christmas Party
themoviechannel.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Life During Wartime
themoviechannel.us.description: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. (Comedy drama) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
themoviechannel.us.description: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. (Comedy) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Daddy's Home
themoviechannel.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
themoviechannel.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Vanilla Sky
themoviechannel.us.description: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: We Were Soldiers
themoviechannel.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Body Cam
themoviechannel.us.description: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Blindness
themoviechannel.us.description: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. (Thriller, Drama) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: The Relic
themoviechannel.us.description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home. (Horror) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Venom
themoviechannel.us.description: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Rumpelstiltskin
themoviechannel.us.description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul. (Horror) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Erotic Obsession
themoviechannel.us.description: Mandy thinks she has found the perfect roommate in her coworker, Michele. But when an innocent comment is misinterpreted by Michele, things quickly escalate from Platonic roommates to full on infatuation. (Adults only, Erotic) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Area 51
themoviechannel.us.description: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada. (Science fiction, Horror, Mystery) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Vanilla Sky
themoviechannel.us.description: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane!
themoviechannel.us.description: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. (Dark comedy) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
themoviechannel.us.description: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver
themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Up in the Air
themoviechannel.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Grumpy Old Men
themoviechannel.us.description: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend. (Comedy) - 1993

themoviechannel.us.title: Grumpier Old Men
themoviechannel.us.description: Elderly, angling and contentious friends Max (Walter Matthau) and John (Jack Lemmon) back-burner their bickering when their kids (Kevin Pollak, Daryl Hannah) get engaged, but fishing season opens a can of romantic worms as newcomer Maria (Sophia Loren) plans to turn their beloved bait shop into a restaurant. Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love. (Comedy) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Best in Show
themoviechannel.us.description: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. (Comedy, LGBTQ) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash. (Game show, Comedy) - 2017-09-04

wupadt.us.title: Beyond the Gates ᴺᵉʷ
wupadt.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others. SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Pickles And Preserves Jamie Oliver provides tips on how to choose the best and most-succulent bird for a family Christmas dinner.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E7 Trieste's International Flavors The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement. She cooks recipes inspired by her Zia Nina - mussels triestine, orange raspberry spritz, and a coffee panna cotta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E7 The Magic Of Mata Ortiz Pati visits the village of Mata Ortiz to learn about the exquisite pottery it's known for.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Bread And Desserts Chef Mark loves baking and working in the pastry section in top restaurants. He creates four recipes - chocolate honeycomb squares, buttery garlic brioche bread, focaccia, then a chocolate souffle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Neil Forster With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Taking Off In America You eat at an airport because you have to, not because you want to. But just beyond the departure terminals you'll find smoky BBQ, sweet fluffy pancakes and a bowl of warm borbor-all worth it.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Broome: Ali & Mitch Torres Final Episode Kangaroo Stew with bacon, soya & vegetables & Kangaroo Satays with a Spicy Chilli Peanut Sauce: Ali & Mitch draw on their family influences from the Djugan/Gooniyandi & Philipino & Malay heritage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Bugoynes: Little Finland In Norway Journey to Bugoynes, a remote fishing village at the edge of Norway, where Finnish heritage and Arctic traditions thrive.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E12 Episode 12 Things get a little risky when Laura makes Fermented Chilli Oil. Third-generation farmer Catherine Velisha adds some Veggies to Charlie Carrington's Spiced Rump Cap.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Pollo Al Mattone Rachael prepares a traditional pollo al mattone, an Italian roast chicken, by generously seasoning spatchcock chickens, cooking them in a pan with a brick wrapped in tin foil.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E6 Yarra Valley Still in Victoria, Hayden is off to the Yarra Valley to find juicy apples from Montagues before heading up the range to try his hand at trout fishing, and of course we'll be dropping into a winery.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 Today we're celebrating diverse flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E7 Episode 7 Laura starts her day making her Bircher Muesli with a twist, before her Italian heritage comes out with a delicious Creamy Roasted Capsicum Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Rick visits Cork in Southern Ireland. At the English Market, the gastronomic heart of the city, he talks to retailers and cooks Corned Beef and Cabbage. Still in Eire, he travels up the east coast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E36 Episode 36 Justine and Guest Darren show some of their classic staple recipes including Mexican Mac and Cheese, Curried Scrambled Eggs and Coffee and Cacao Maple Granola Clusters.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E69 Special Treats Two very special guests, comedian Alex Ward and dessert legend Adriano Zumbo, join Adam in the kitchen for a night full of very special treats.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Episode 3 Eva proves that speedy cooking doesn't mean sacrificing flavour. She kicks off with Chinese Style Garlic Butter Spaghetti, a garlicky, rich pasta that's ready in minutes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Christine Anu Chef Matt Moran and Christine Anu celebrate her Torres Strait Islander heritage through cherished dishes, heartfelt memories, and a moving exchange of culture and connection.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Tokyo Tony's first visit to Tokyo launches him into the world of meticulously crafted Japanese breads: guided by the practice of 'Kaizen', a philosophy of continuous improvement that permeates the culture.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Paris Tony visits one of his favourite cities in the world, Paris. It's hard to do too much of anything when your cup's being constantly refilled with amazing wine and there's a cheese plate to turn to.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Tohoku Adam Liaw goes to sea with the Japanese fishermen who caught the 'million dollar tuna', and then meets the soy sauce maker who saved most of his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Lamb Jamie gets a visit from Daphne, a Welsh sheep farmer, and they talk about some of the misconceptions of spring lamb, the differences between lamb, hogget and mutton and animal's good conditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E8 Wheat Harvest And Pasta Lidia talks the hard work involved with making flour, then bread and pasta. She makes croutons with a Caesar salad, then a fusilli with spinach and herbed ricotta, and a lagane pasta with chickpeas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E8 Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese Pati explores the culture of the mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Dining In Chef Mark loves throwing a dinner party for his friends and family. He's reviving the classic prawn cocktail, then an epic beef wellington, and lastly a trick to a make a creme caramel.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Travis Francis Lorraine Pascale creates a menu inspired by a student's Caribbean roots.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 A Chilli Love Story Noorman and Puti are a husband-and-wife duo who founded Nasi Lemak Ayam Taliwang, which combines the Singaporean Malay dish Nasi Lemak from Noorman's heritage, and the Indonesian dish Ayam Taliwang.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Broome: Pat Torres Gubinge Jam with Bush Fig & Bush Fig Cup Cakes with a Bush Passion Fruit Icing: Ali & Mitch join their cousin Pat to learn how to whip up some sweet treats using local bush fruits found in the region.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Aukra / Ona: Island Traditions and Innovation Exploring local delicacies, alternative farm schools and entrepreneurs making flake salt from ocean water on the rugged islands of Aukra and Ona; a gas processing plant that powers the U.K.; a modern salmon processing plant.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E13 Episode 13 Back in the market, Laura is joined by dietitian Simone Austin to prepare the ever-popular Bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 International Pub Cheese Burger Rachael takes the traditional beef burgers to the next level by adding homemade pub cheese topping, sauteed sweet onions, jalapeno peppers, and bacon on a pretzel bun, sealed with lettuce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E7 Cobden Hayden is heading to the heart of Australia's dairy country to see a dairy farm and butter factory in action, but first, we're at the iconic 12 Apostles for a start to the day we'll never forget.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 We are serving up pure comfort today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E8 Episode 8 Laura makes Sushi accessible to the home cook before she heads to the famous wine region of the Barossa Valley and makes an Asian-inspired Chicken Noodle Stir Fry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 Rick is on home turf when he visits the Tintagel area in Cornwall. Here, legend has it, the ruined castle atop the craggy, untamed cliffs is what remains of King Arthur's Camelot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E37 Episode 37 Guest Sashi joins Justine on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet where she shares her Spiced Lamb Wrap recipe. Later, Justine makes a Tuna and Fennel Polpette and some Olive Oil Fried Potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E70 Pickles The one and only Peter Kuruvita and the one and only Dave Hughes make a dill with Adam tonight, they're all going to cook with pickles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 North Scotland Rick and Chalky round off their journey of the UK at John O'Groats, visiting Rick's favourite deli in Edinburgh, a fish smokery in Argyll, enjoying freshly cooked lobster on Crail harbour front.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Get Up And Go Kickstart the day with unbeatable fast and fabulous breakfasts. From weekend parties to pancake feasts, working breakfasts, solo comforts and wake up shakes, Nigella's got mornings covered.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Rome Situated in Lazio, the ancient city of Rome is often overlooked in the gastronomic department. Stanley Tucci meets up with an old friend, Claudia della Frattina, and they head out to explore.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Torres Strait At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E2 Wattleseed Damper With Golden Syrup Butter Torres Strait Islander chef and owner of Mabu Mabu, Nornie Bero, cooks and talks through some of her favourite easy recipes, from quick-pickled octopus to fresh-baked damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Philadelphia Tony finally does Philadelphia! 36 hours of food, drink, history and art-and absolutely no cheesesteaks. Tony meets up with Marc Vetri for modern Israeli food at Michael Solomonov's Zahav.

woio.us.title: Beyond the Gates ᴺᵉʷ
woio.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others. (Soap, Drama) - 2025-02-24

kmph.us.title: The Simpsons
kmph.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

fxm.us.description: A clever Persian barber (John Derek) wows the harem and wins a princess (Elaine Stewart) by saving her from an evil prince. (Adventure) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Egyptian
fxm.us.description: In ancient Egypt, Sinuhe (Edmund Purdom) is a would-be doctor who saves the life of a young man (Michael Wilding) suffering from a seizure. When the afflicted youth awakes, he introduces himself as the Pharaoh Akhnaton and makes Sinuhe the royal healer. While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton. (Historical drama) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The 300 Spartans
fxm.us.description: Xerxes of Persia invades Greece with his army; Leonidas (Richard Egan) of Sparta fights back at Thermopylae. (Historical drama) - 1962

fxm.us.title: The Lion
fxm.us.description: Living an idyllic existence on a Kenyan wildlife preserve, Tina (Pamela Franklin) is remarkably at home with the resident animals. In fact, she is so comfortable with the various creatures that her best friend is an adult lion. While Tina isn't too worried by this relationship, her mother, Christine (Capucine), becomes extremely concerned, and requests that her ex-husband -- Tina's father, Robert (William Holden) -- come for a visit to help straighten the girl out. (Drama, Adventure) - 1962

fxm.us.title: Wizards
fxm.us.description: After the death of his mother, the evil mutant wizard Blackwolf (Steve Gravers) discovers some long-lost military technologies. Full of ego and ambition, Blackwolf claims his mother's throne, assembles an army and sets out to brainwash and conquer Earth. Meanwhile, Blackwolf's gentle twin brother, the bearded and sage Avatar (Bob Holt), calls upon his own magical abilities to foil Blackwolf's plans for world domination -- even if it means destroying his own flesh and blood. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
fxm.us.description: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Death on the Nile
fxm.us.description: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot's Egyptian vacation aboard a glamorous river steamer turns into a terrifying search for a murderer when a picture-perfect couple's idyllic honeymoon is tragically cut short. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Death on the Nile
