fxm.us.title: Freud's Last Session
fxm.us.description: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind. (Drama) - 2023

fxm.us.title: Let's Make Love
fxm.us.description: One of the wealthiest men in the world, Jean-Marc Clement (Yves Montand) is rich in money, but lacking in love. While seeking someone who adores him for his personality rather than his fortune, Clement learns that he is the subject of a satirical theater production. Unrecognized as he visits the play's set, Clement is offered the part as himself by the show's unwitting producers, and he takes the gig to be close to the gorgeous yet down-to-earth actress Amanda Dell (Marilyn Monroe). (Musical comedy) - 1960

fxm.us.title: High Anxiety
fxm.us.description: Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety. (Comedy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Detective
fxm.us.description: When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case. (Crime drama, LGBTQ) - 1968

fxm.us.title: The French Connection
fxm.us.description: New York Detective Popeye Doyle (Gene Hackman) and his partner (Roy Scheider) chase a French heroin smuggler. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979

fxm.us.title: Alien: Romulus
fxm.us.description: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station. (Science fiction, Horror) - 2024

bbcamerica.us.description: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh. (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. bouncetv.us.title: Gemini Man

bouncetv.us.title: Colombiana

Leaving a lipstick drawing of her namesake on every victim, Cataleya carries out her assignments with efficiency and dreams of avenging her family. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

bouncetv.us.title: Miss Bala

Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Adventure) - 2019

bouncetv.us.title: Alex Cross
bouncetv.us.description: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

365blk.us.title: Passenger 57
365blk.us.description: John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers. (Action) - 1992

365blk.us.title: Training Day
365blk.us.description: Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost? (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2001

365blk.us.title: Three Kings
365blk.us.description: Just after the end of the Gulf War, four American soldiers decide to steal a cache of Saddam Hussein's hidden gold. Led by Sergeant Major Archie Gates, three of the men are rescued by rebels, but Sergeant Troy Barlow is captured and tortured by Iraqi intelligence. The Iraqi rebels beg for the American trio to help fight against the impending arrival of Hussein's Elite Guard. The men agree to fight in return for help rescuing Troy. (War, Comedy drama) - 1999

365blk.us.title: Shaft in Africa
365blk.us.description: When private investigator and man of action John Shaft is hired to disrupt a slavery ring, he must travel to Africa and infiltrate the criminal operation. While undercover, Shaft discovers that Africans are being abducted and sold as slaves in Europe, with a sinister figure named Amafi pulling the strings. As Shaft gets closer to taking down Amafi, his situation becomes increasingly dangerous, with assassins and thugs seemingly lurking around every corner. (Crime drama, Action, Adventure) - 1973

365blk.us.title: Ricochet

However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek

cinevault.us.title: Wild America
cinevault.us.description: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West. (Movie, Feature Film, Comedy drama) - 19970702

cinevault.us.title: Alpha
cinevault.us.description: Young Keda tries to survive alone in the wilderness after he's left for dead during his first hunt with his Cro-Magnon tribe. He soon forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, Keda and the wolf must now trek through a harsh and unforgiving landscape to make it home before winter. (Movie, Feature Film, Adventure, Drama, Action) - 20180817

cinevault.us.title: Legends of the Fall
cinevault.us.description: In early 20th-century Montana, Col. William Ludlow (Anthony Hopkins) lives in the wilderness with his sons, Tristan (Brad Pitt), Alfred (Aidan Quinn) and Samuel (Henry Thomas). Eventually, the unconventional but close-knit family encounters tragedy when Samuel is killed in World War I. Tristan and Alfred survive their tours of duty, but, soon after they return home, both men fall for Samuel's gorgeous fiancée, Susannah (Julia Ormond), and their intense rivalry begins to destroy the family. cinevault.us.description: A successful advertising executive, David Basner, is working on a project that could make him partner at his company. mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Man of the West
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Ex-outlaw Link Jones (Gary Cooper) is aboard a train when it is robbed by bandits. When he tries to intervene, he's knocked out and left in the middle of nowhere with saloon singer Billie (Julie London), whom he hoped to hire as a schoolteacher in his town, and Sam (Arthur O'Connell), a con man. Link brings the three to his nearby former home, now the hideout for the bandits, who are led by his uncle (Lee J. Cobb) -- and to save his new friends, he must rejoin the old gang for one last holdup. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 19581001

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: God Forgives, I Don't
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Action) - 1967

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: From Noon Till Three
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Comedy) - 1976

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Valdez Is Coming
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Drama) - 19711204

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Gunslinger
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 1956

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Five Guns West
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men -- John Morgan Candy (Bob Campbell), William Parcel Candy (Jonathan Haze), J.C. Haggard (Paul Birch), Hale Clinton (Touch Connors) and Govern Sturges (John Lund) -- are to travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach carrying Confederate traitor and spy Stephen Jethro (Jack Ingram) and gold. However, when they realize that a woman (Dorothy Malone) is also present, it complicates their mission. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 19550415

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Cannon for Cordoba
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli). (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Action, Romance) - 19701103

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Spikes Gang
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Will (Gary Grimes), Les (Ron Howard) and Tod (Charlie Martin Smith), teenage farm boys living near the Mexican border, stumble upon Harry Spikes (Lee Marvin), a local bandit near death in the middle of nowhere. After helping bring the aging man back to health, the trio decide to escape their humdrum lives by becoming outlaws themselves. Failing at their first attempt to rob a bank, the boys convince the gruff Spikes to teach them the ways of the desperado. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 1974

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Hour of the Gun
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Drama) - 19671010

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

retroplex.us.title: Cariboo Trail
retroplex.us.description: Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. While they are resting one night, their herd is robbed by a gang of thugs, leaving the cowboys stranded in the wilderness without their livelihood. Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again. (Western) - 1950

(Special, Documentary, Biography, Entertainment) - 2017-01-01

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Tumbleweed Trail
retroplex.us.description: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Flaming Bullets
retroplex.us.description: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Yankee Fakir
retroplex.us.description: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing. (Mystery) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Man From Oklahoma
retroplex.us.description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: The Star Packer
retroplex.us.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Colorado Serenade
retroplex.us.description: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe). (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: In Old Amarillo
retroplex.us.description: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Twilight in the Sierras
retroplex.us.description: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez). (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: Cariboo Trail
retroplex.us.description: Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Brother Outlaw

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Monster Jam At Monster Jam, custom-built monster trucks roll, flip and fly through the air; with the metal-bending beating these trucks endure, teams of specialized mechanics race against the clock to repair these engineering marvels in time for the next event. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E02 Volcano Power Mike is in Iceland, where teams harness the power of volcanos to keep the geothermal energy flowing; they battle harsh weather to maintain and upgrade giant power systems, fixing miles of steam pipes, and bringing a dead well back to life. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E03 Water Work In Florida, Mike tackles one of the dangerous jobs on the planet, commercial diving; he helps a specialized team keep waterways safe; fixing construction site leaks and removing dangerous structures, all while hurricane season is in full swing. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E01 Afterburn In Southern California, crews rebuild after the 2025 wildfires, cutting firebreaks, repairing emergency water systems, hardening roads and power lines, and building fire-resistant homes before the next firestorm. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E04 Sky Rides In the Alps of Switzerland, Mike helps an elite team install a new cable (rope) system on an iconic mountain gondola line, helps fix the world's steepest cogwheel railway track and explores mountaintop family farms only accessible. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

shadesofblack.us.title: A Haunted House
shadesofblack.us.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. (Comedy, Horror) - 2013

shadesofblack.us.title: A Haunted House 2
shadesofblack.us.description: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. (Comedy, Horror) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Meet the Blacks
shadesofblack.us.description: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: Fifty Shades of Black
shadesofblack.us.description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: 4Play

shadesofblack.us.title: Snipes
shadesofblack.us.description: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Beyond the Lights
shadesofblack.us.description: Though she's been groomed for stardom all her life by an overbearing mother (Minnie Driver), singer Noni (Gugu Mbatha-Raw) is having trouble dealing with her success. Feeling unable to cope any longer, Noni tries to kill herself, but luckily Kaz (Nate Parker), the police officer assigned to be her bodyguard, thwarts her suicide attempt. tastemade.us.description: Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
tastemade.us.description: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
tastemade.us.description: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

(Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie explores Hawaii's O'ahu island to get nourished from fresh tuna poke, heartfelt Pho, and hand-pounded poi. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Quail, Alligator Sausage, & Gumbo in New Orleans
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie stops by New Orleans to chow down on lacquered quail, a beast of a Po Boy, and Creole Beef Daube. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-06

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Food Meets Art
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
tastemadetravel.us.description: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Art of the Egg
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Best Tacos In Mérida
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Getting to the Roots
tastemadetravel.us.description: The chefs and owners of Xokol restaurant in Guadalajara reconnect with their roots; chef Marin creates a drink and dessert inspired by his grandmother; chef Francisco Migoya makes a dessert. (Cooking) - 2021-10-27

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Hunting for Ancient Spices in Thekkady

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Celebrating Diwali in Chennai

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Exploring the Night Markets of Bangalore

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin

Austin may be weird, but the food is fabulous. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-13

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Brooklyn's Best Pizza Tour
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio

universalmovies.us.title: Army of Darkness
universalmovies.us.description: 3rd Evil Dead movie. Ash finds himself trapped in medieval times. He must quest for the Necronomicon, a book of evil which can return him to his time. Unfortunately, he releases the evil trapped inside the book and unleashes an army of the dead. (Movie, Feature Film, Fantasy, Adventure, Horror) - 19920219

universalmovies.us.title: Land of the Dead
universalmovies.us.description: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie hoard that can learn and adapt. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror) - 20050624

universalmovies.us.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
universalmovies.us.description: Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror) - 19950711

universalmovies.us.title: Frenzy
universalmovies.us.description: London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster), however Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller) - 19720621

universalmovies.us.title: Serial Mom
universalmovies.us.description: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer. (Movie, Feature Film, Comedy) - 19940413

universalmovies.us.title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
universalmovies.us.description: Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case. (Movie, Feature Film, Action, Comedy) - 19920530

universalmovies.us.title: Streets of Fire
universalmovies.us.description: Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back. (Movie, Feature Film, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 19840601

universalmovies.us.title: Sneakers
universalmovies.us.description: Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller, Comedy) - 19920909

universalmovies.us.title: The Car
universalmovies.us.description: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Action, Mystery) - 19770813

universalmovies.us.title: Black Dog

universalmovies.us.title: The Jackal
universalmovies.us.description: During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller, Action) - 19971114

universalmovies.us.title: Mercury Rising
universalmovies.us.description: "Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller, Action) - 19980403

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue
waypointtv.us.description: Charter boat captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker combine their distinctly different fishing styles and skills to produce this action-packed offshore fishing series. Rodger has a lifetime of fishing and diving experience in the waters surrounding the Florida Keys, and many "Into the Blue" episodes feature his underwater videography as he hunts for the ocean's predators. Walker is a proven performer in big-game billfish tournaments and has fished the waters of the Florida Keys and the Mid-Atlantic for more than 25 years. Together, in the search for yellowfin tuna, red snapper, sharks, sailfish, mahi-mahi or marlin, they demonstrate how to make an offshore fishing adventure a success. (Show, Sports non-event, Outdoors) - 20100213

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Mayas, Aztecs, and Incas
truehistory.us.description: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Europeans and Africans
truehistory.us.description: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - European Overseas Expansion
truehistory.us.description: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Christopher Columbus-Path to Conquest
truehistory.us.description: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean
truehistory.us.description: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions, conquering and annihilating native peoples, establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Rise of Hernán Cortés
truehistory.us.description: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes, capturing Montezuma in his own palace. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - George Washington's Doubts
truehistory.us.description: Explaining the importance of getting a well-rounded understanding of the Founders; Professor Guelzo explores Washington's fears about post-Revolutionary America; Washington's concerns about how people could administer their own affairs. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Thomas Mifflin's Congress
truehistory.us.description: Before the ratification of the Constitution, there are presidents of the Congress created by the Articles of Confederation; the failures of one president, Thomas Mifflin, offer a window into the problems facing the United States of America in 1783. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Robert Morris's Money
truehistory.us.description: Money issues abound in the new United States; why the abundance of land is a problem; what compels states to print their own paper money; how Robert Morris attempts to restore the links between commerce, agriculture and government finances. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Benjamin Franklin's Leather Apron
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the many roles Benjamin Franklin plays in the formative years of the republic; this includes his part as an independent printer, a public "gentleman", a nobleman of nature and a tradesman cynical of the wealthy and powerful. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - America: Forged in War
truehistory.us.description: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - George Washington Takes Command
truehistory.us.description: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Redcoats Fall to the Continental Army
truehistory.us.description: Washington's army is in dire straits; his command is in question; he revives his reputation with the famous crossing of the Delaware River; the next four years of the American Revolution, which see Britain's strategic advantage deteriorate. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Andrew Jackson and the War of 1812
truehistory.us.description: Why the United States chooses to fight Britain in the War of 1812; America's grievances and ambitions, which include the conquest of Canada; the poor strategy, command and training that lead to a strategic stalemate; the exception is Andrew Jackson. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - America's Founding Ideas
truehistory.us.description: Start the course on the U.S. Constitution by learning about the English culture that inspired American law and the conflict with England that caused the revolution. (American history) - 2023-11-23

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - Failures of Early American Governments
truehistory.us.description: Consider where the Articles of Confederation came from. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - Dilemmas of the Constitutional Convention
truehistory.us.description: Witness the heated discussions surrounding the establishment of a new form of national governance. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - The Ratification of the Constitution
truehistory.us.description: Reach back to the end of the eighteenth century and explore the attitudes of the various states towards the establishment of a unified federal government. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Emancipation and the Civil War
truehistory.us.description: Studying relics and documents related to the emancipation of slaves during the Civil War era; General Lee's surrender at Appomattox; poignant stories told by artifacts from the Smithsonian's National Museum of African American History and Culture. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Gold, Guns, and Grandeur - The West
truehistory.us.description: The tale told by a tiny gold flake, which launches the California Gold Rush in the late 1840s. The Colt revolver has a profound impact; the West through the eyes of both settlers and natives in Albert Bierstadt's art; Sitting Bull's drawing book. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - The First Americans - Then and Now
truehistory.us.description: Stone points produced at the end of the last ice age by the Clovis culture of early hunter-gatherers in the Americas; the mystery of the birdman carving found in an ancient Native American burial mound; tribal traditions inspire Indian artists. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Planes, Trains, Automobiles ... and Wagons

classica.us.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
classica.us.description: Die italienische Oper wurde 2013 in der Opéra Royal de Liège in Belgien aufgenommen. Verdis "La forza del destino" wurde 1862 im Bolschoi-Theater in Sankt Petersburg uraufgeführt. Diese Version stammt vom Orchester der Opéra Royal de Wallonie. (Special, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2019-11-10

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2019 - Finale: Haydn, Schubert et al
classica.us.description: Die Sendung präsentiert das Halbfinale des internationalen Gesangswettbewerbs von 2019. Diesmal treten die Mezzosopranistin Ema Nikolovska aus Kanada und der Pianist Michael Sikich aus den Vereinigten Staaten an. Sie präsentieren verschiedene Stücke. (Music, Classical) - 2023-04-03

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 3 in G-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-11

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Mozart und Schostakowitsch
classica.us.description: Der Geiger Renaud Capuçon tritt beim Festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly auf und spielt Kammermusik aus dem klassischen Repertoire und dem Repertoire des 20. Jahrhunderts. Er tritt mit den Solisten der Internationalen Menuhin-Musikakademie auf. (Music) - 2024-12-13

classica.us.title: Beethoven Egmont Ouverture, Tsjaikovski Symfonie 4
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Nicolás Pasquet leitet das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet der Reina Sofía. Auf dem Programm steht die Egmont-Ouvertüre von Ludwig van Beethoven, Op. 84 und Pjotr Iljitsch Tschaikowskis Sinfonie Nr. 4 in f-Moll, Op. 36. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-16

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klaviersonate Nr. 5, KV 283
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Roberto Prosseda spielt die fünfte Klaviersonate von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-09-03

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Streichquartett Nr. 7 & 13 und Große Fuge
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène hat anlässlich des 250. Geburtstages von Ludwig van Beethoven alle 16 Streichquartette des Komponisten aufgenommen. In dieser Sendung spielt Quatuor Ébène Beethovens Streichquartett Nr. 7 in F-Dur, Op. 133. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-03

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2017-08-24

classica.us.title: Brahms - Tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81
classica.us.description: Maestro Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Brahms und der Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan' von Mahler. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-06-13

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-21

classica.us.title: Mozart - 35. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Der bekannte Dirigent Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam in einer gelungenen Aufführung von Mozarts Sinfonie Nummer 35 D-Dur KV 385. Diese wurde im Jahr 2020 in der Nieuwe Kerk in Den Haag in den Niederlanden aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-28

classica.us.title: Prokofjew - Cinderella
classica.us.description: Präsentiert wird Prokofjews Cinderella in einer Darbietung des Malandain Ballett Biarritz. Sergei Prokofjew schrieb das Ballettstück zu einem Libretto von Nikolai Wolkow. Diese Choreografie stammt aus der Feder von Thierry Malandain. (Special, Ballet) - 2018-12-21

classica.us.title: Barockwerke von Bach, Muffat und Rameau
classica.us.description: Paul Goodwin dirigiert das Conjunto Barroco. Auf dem Programm steht unter anderem Muffats Sonata Nr. 5 in G-Dur. Diese Aufführung wurde am 8. Februar 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid aufgenommen. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-19

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 4, komponiert zwischen 1899 und 1901, schildert die kindliche Vorstellung vom Himmel, ein zentrales Thema, das den unschuldigen und lyrischen Charakter des Werkes prägt. (Special, Music) - 2026-02-28

classica.us.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-05

classica.us.title: Tschaikowsky - Ouvertüre-Fantasie aus Romeo & Julia
classica.us.description: Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam in einer Aufführung von Peter Iljitsch Tschaikowskys Ouvertüren-Fantasie „Romeo und Julia". Unter seiner Leitung hat sich der Klangkörper zu einem beliebten Orchester in den Niederlanden entwickelt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-30

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn und Gershwin für 2 Klaviere
classica.us.description: Zwei italienische Pianisten interpretieren gemeinsam Mozarts Klaviersonate in D für zwei Klaviere, Mendelssohns Klaviersonate für zwei Klaviere in D und Gershwins "Rhapsody in Blue" in einem Konzertprogramm aus dem Fazioli-Saal in Sacile. (Special, Music) - 2021-02-13

classica.us.title: Schubert - Vier Impromptus, op. 90
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist spielt unter anderem Mozarts fünfte Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jumping Stick
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Racquet Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caravan Friends
nickjrtoo.uk.description: After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car! Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Birthday Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Broken Party Bus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken bus. This is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Living Above the Shops
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roof Top Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Blaze And The Monster Machines - Meatball Mayhem
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Crusher accidentally knocks a bottle of "grow spice" onto a meatball, it grows to enormous size and rolls away! Blaze and Pickle to transform into robots and stop it. (Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids, Children) - 2014

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Blue's Clues & You! - The Case of the Missing Thinking Chair
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The Thinking Chair is MISSING! This is a mystery so huge that Josh and Blue need to call in the Blueprints Detective Agency for Steve's help. (Animation, Comedy, Kids, Children) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Viking Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Potato's Fruit & Vegetable Quiz
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Potato visits the school to talk about fruit and vegetables. But which team will win his quiz. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Botanical Gardens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Breakfast Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Perfect Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Penny Polar Bear's Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They have great fun learning to play. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Snowy Mountain
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Olden Days
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fish Pond
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fish pond he used to visit when he was a little piggy. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Circus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends decide Grandpa Pig's tent is a perfect place to put on a circus. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit in Space
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pirate Treasure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pirate Peppa and friends put together a chest of treasure and bury it in a marked spot. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E13 Pickles And Preserves Jamie Oliver provides tips on how to choose the best and most-succulent bird for a family Christmas dinner.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E7 Trieste's International Flavors The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement. She cooks recipes inspired by her Zia Nina - mussels triestine, orange raspberry spritz, and a coffee panna cotta.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S13 E7 The Magic Of Mata Ortiz Pati visits the village of Mata Ortiz to learn about the exquisite pottery it's known for.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E7 Bread And Desserts Chef Mark loves baking and working in the pastry section in top restaurants. He creates four recipes - chocolate honeycomb squares, buttery garlic brioche bread, focaccia, then a chocolate souffle.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Neil Forster With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E7 Taking Off In America You eat at an airport because you have to, not because you want to. But just beyond the departure terminals you'll find smoky BBQ, sweet fluffy pancakes and a bowl of warm borbor-all worth it.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E9 Broome: Ali & Mitch Torres Final Episode Kangaroo Stew with bacon, soya & vegetables & Kangaroo Satays with a Spicy Chilli Peanut Sauce: Ali & Mitch draw on their family influences from the Djugan/Gooniyandi & Philipino & Malay heritage.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: People Of The North
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E6 Bugoynes: Little Finland In Norway Journey to Bugoynes, a remote fishing village at the edge of Norway, where Finnish heritage and Arctic traditions thrive.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E12 Episode 12 Things get a little risky when Laura makes Fermented Chilli Oil. Third-generation farmer Catherine Velisha adds some Veggies to Charlie Carrington's Spiced Rump Cap.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E12 Pollo Al Mattone Rachael prepares a traditional pollo al mattone, an Italian roast chicken, by generously seasoning spatchcock chickens, cooking them in a pan with a brick wrapped in tin foil.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E6 Yarra Valley Still in Victoria, Hayden is off to the Yarra Valley to find juicy apples from Montagues before heading up the range to try his hand at trout fishing, and of course we'll be dropping into a winery.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 Today we're celebrating diverse flavours.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E7 Episode 7 Laura starts her day making her Bircher Muesli with a twist, before her Italian heritage comes out with a delicious Creamy Roasted Capsicum Pasta.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Rick visits Cork in Southern Ireland. At the English Market, the gastronomic heart of the city, he talks to retailers and cooks Corned Beef and Cabbage. Still in Eire, he travels up the east coast.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E36 Episode 36 Justine and Guest Darren show some of their classic staple recipes including Mexican Mac and Cheese, Curried Scrambled Eggs and Coffee and Cacao Maple Granola Clusters.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E69 Special Treats Two very special guests, comedian Alex Ward and dessert legend Adriano Zumbo, join Adam in the kitchen for a night full of very special treats.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E3 Episode 3 Eva proves that speedy cooking doesn't mean sacrificing flavour. She kicks off with Chinese Style Garlic Butter Spaghetti, a garlicky, rich pasta that's ready in minutes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Christine Anu Chef Matt Moran and Christine Anu celebrate her Torres Strait Islander heritage through cherished dishes, heartfelt memories, and a moving exchange of culture and connection.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Tokyo Tony's first visit to Tokyo launches him into the world of meticulously crafted Japanese breads: guided by the practice of 'Kaizen', a philosophy of continuous improvement that permeates the culture.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E2 Paris Tony visits one of his favourite cities in the world, Paris. It's hard to do too much of anything when your cup's being constantly refilled with amazing wine and there's a cheese plate to turn to.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Tohoku Adam Liaw goes to sea with the Japanese fishermen who caught the 'million dollar tuna', and then meets the soy sauce maker who saved most of his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E69 Special Treats Two very special guests, comedian Alex Ward and dessert legend Adriano Zumbo, join Adam in the kitchen for a night full of very special treats.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
